jobs.title: Field Services Project Manager
jobs.description:
Power your future with Qualus
in your Specialized Feild Services Department as a Field Service Project Managers. Your responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing field service projects while ensuring compliance with customer requirements, safety standards, quality expectations, and financial objectives. This role serves as the primary liaison between customers, field personnel, operations, and sales teams, managing project scope, schedules, resources, materials, communications, and project profitability from inception through completion.

Responsibilities

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Serve as the primary customer contact for project communications, issue resolution, and scope clarification.
Assess customer requirements, qualify opportunities, and support proposal development and project estimating activities.
Review project specifications, contracts, and work orders to ensure a clear understanding of project scope and deliverables.
Develop, maintain, and execute project schedules to ensure successful and timely completion of work.
Coordinate labor, equipment, materials, subcontractors, and other resources required for project execution.
Partner with Operations and field teams to optimize resource allocation and workforce scheduling.
Conduct site visits and job walks to evaluate project requirements, field conditions, and scope changes.
Monitor project progress and provide leadership to ensure safety, quality, productivity, and schedule adherence.
Maintain accountability for project financial performance, including budgets, costs, change orders, and profitability.
Prepare and manage project documentation, customer correspondence, reports, and submittals.
Provide technical support and guidance related to power apparatus testing and field service operations as needed.
Participate in production and planning meetings to communicate project status, resource needs, and execution plans.
Ensure compliance with all customer contracts, company procedures, and applicable safety and regulatory requirements.
Support continuous improvement efforts to enhance project execution, communication, and operational efficiency.

Minimum Qualifications

High School Diploma, technical school and/or bachelors degree preferred.
4 + years related experience in power plants, industrial services, primary power distribution and related protection and control schemes. Electrical apparatus and switchgear experience is required.
Licensures and Certifications: NETA 2, 3, or 4 preferred.
Strong project management, scheduling, and resource coordination skills.
Experience managing project budgets, costs, and profitability.
Knowledge of electrical testing, power apparatus, substations, or related industrial environments.
Strong customer relationship management and communication skills.
Ability to analyze problems, make sound decisions, and manage multiple priorities.
Proficiency with electrical testing software, Microsoft Office, and project management systems.
Demonstrated commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across teams.
Ability to travel and work flexible hours as business needs require.

Benefits & Compensation

Qualus benefits offered include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short and Long-Term Disability, 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, EAP, Parental Leave, Paid time off, and Holidays, for those who qualify.

The final salary awarded for this role may vary from the above range based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. The salary range provided in this job posting may be subject to change for business purposes.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 2,000 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on any grounds protected by applicable human rights legislation across Canada and the US.

We are committed to a secure and transparent hiring process. We do not request payment or sensitive personal information, such as Social Security numbers or banking details, during the application process. Please use caution and verify opportunities through our official channels.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Ad Measurements Science
jobs.description:
Description

Application deadline: Aug 30, 2026

The Ads Measurement Science team in the Measurement, Ad Tech, and Data Science (MADS) team of Amazon Ads serves a centralized role developing solutions for a multitude of performance measurement products. We create solutions which measure the comprehensive impact of advertiser's ad spend, including sales impacts both online and offline and across timescales, and provide actionable insights that enable our advertisers to optimize their media portfolios. We also own the science solutions for AI tools that unlock new insights and automate high-effort customer workflows, such as custom query and report generation based on natural language user requests. We leverage a host of scientific technologies to accomplish this mission, including Generative AI, classical ML, Causal Inference, Natural Language Processing, and Computer Vision.

As a Principal Technical Program Manager on the team, you will be at the forefront of innovation, driving program execution on some of the most high ambiguity, high impact initiatives within Ads. You will work across Product, Science, and Engineering to drive AI initiatives spanning VP organizations, including 1) our Analyst Agent which will work alongside other ads agents to transform the performance reporting and insights experience for advertisers, and 2) our Ads Customer Journey Model, which seeks to revolutionize our measurement, planning, and optimization experiences through foundational customer journey understanding. You will own the planning, execution, and delivery of large-scale technical programs that span multiple teams, product organizations, and business stakeholders. You'll work at the intersection of advertising technology, machine learning, and distributed systems to solve ambiguous problems that shape the future of digital advertising.

Key job responsibilities

Own end-to-end program management for strategic advertising technology initiatives spanning multiple teams and organizations
Drive technical strategy and roadmap alignment across engineering, product, science, and business teams
Lead cross-functional teams through complex technical challenges in areas such as ad serving, campaign management, measurement, and optimization
Establish program governance, metrics, and reporting mechanisms to ensure visibility and accountability at the VP level
Identify and mitigate technical and operational risks across large-scale distributed systems serving billions of ad requests daily
Partner with engineering leaders to influence architecture decisions and ensure scalability, reliability, and performance
Build and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders across Amazon Ads, AWS, and Retail organizations
Drive operational excellence through process improvements, automation, and best practices
Mentor and develop other TPMs across the organization
Represent Amazon Ads technical programs in executive-level reviews and planning sessions

A day in the life

You will solve real-world problems by getting and analyzing large amounts of data, generate business insights and opportunities, design simulations and experiments, and develop statistical and ML models. The team is driven by business needs, which requires collaboration with other Scientists, Engineers, and Product Managers across the advertising organization. You will prepare written and verbal presentations to share insights to audiences of varying levels of technical sophistication.

Team video https://advertising.amazon.com/help/G4LNN5YWHP6SM9TJ

We are a team of scientists across Applied, Research, Data Science and Economist disciplines. You will work with colleagues with deep expertise in ML, NLP, CV, Gen AI, and Causal Inference with a diverse range of backgrounds. We partner closely with top-notch engineers, product managers, sales leaders, and other scientists with expertise in the ads industry to build scalable modeling and software solutions.

jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a dynamic and rapidly growing business within Amazon and the leader in providing secure, reliable, scalable, and innovative services that help over a million businesses, governments, education, and not for profits across the globe scale and grow! AWS provides a wide set of scalable services to meet customer needs. The organization comprises two specialized teams: Strategic Customer Engagements, which guide transformative deals with industry leaders, and Private Pricing Programs & Experiences, which scales and optimizes pricing solutions across our diverse customer base. Within GDSP, you will develop deep expertise in cloud economics, hone your strategic thinking, and directly impact AWS's market leadership while working with latest technologies and global clients.

Key job responsibilities

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to join the Analytics & Insights team within AWS Global Deal Strategy & Programs (GDSP). In this role, you'll drive operational excellence across our data and analytics portfolio leading prioritization meetings with internal customers, establishing and scaling team-wide processes, and ensuring alignment between engineering, product, and business stakeholders. You'll own the mechanisms that keep our programs on track: intake and prioritization frameworks, delivery cadences, cross-functional coordination, and stakeholder communication. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, brings structure to complex multi-team initiatives, and has a bias for action in a fast-paced environment where data-driven decisions directly impact AWS's commercial motions

We own the end-to-end data platform from core data modeling and pipeline infrastructure to reporting artifacts and self-serve analytics providing data-driven support to Private pricing stake owners across AWS.

We are a high-ownership, fast-moving team consisting of PMT’s, Business intelligence Engineers, Data Engineers and Software development Engineers who thrive in ambiguity and deliver at pace. We manage a broad portfolio spanning multiple business verticals while maintaining a strong bar for data quality, operational rigor, and customer obsession. Our data ecosystem and insights are foundational to how Private Pricing programs are designed, measured, and evolved — directly shaping the strategies that drive AWS's largest and most complex enterprise deals worldwide.

jobs.title: Sr Technical Program Manager, AWS Supply Chain Enablement & Risk Management
jobs.description:
Description

In this role, you will be part of the team that ensures AWS's supply chain can deliver the datacenter racks, servers, and networking equipment to our datacenters across the globe. The rest of the supply chain looks to us to clear strategic problems and "enable" them to focus on execution. We are the jack-of-all-trades with the best understanding of how the entire end-to-end supply chain works and how to help it run better.

This is a high-judgment role, where you will represent the AWS supply chain during engagements with public sector customers, and must be able to translate customer and regulatory requirements into actionable deliverables, determine what is a true requirement versus a nice-to-have, and understand how to find the balance between cybersecurity and business objectives.

The ideal candidate is a technically savvy individual leader, capable of leveraging AWS's internal business and artificial intelligence tool to gather data and identify risks before they become problems, as well as interact with both internal and external senior leaders to gain support for new initiatives and obtain consensus with AWS customers.

You will be responsible for identifying, creating, and delivering on your initiatives and must have both excellent interpersonal and writing skills to work across myriad teams in the supply chain, security, and legal organizations to deliver results in an ambiguous operating environment. It will be your responsibility to ensure the supply chain delivers on our security and risk management commitments to our customers, as well as make sure region build and operational teams are able to get the infrastructure hardware they need when they need it.

This position requires that the selected candidate already be a UK citizen and, after starting, obtain the commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities

Driving consensus and standardization for acceptable levels of risk and best practices across supply chain operations
Developing technical solutions that drive automation at scale to ensure datacenter infrastructure is delivered on-time, in-full
Proactively working with other organizations to anticipate gaps between teams, processes, and system architectures, influencing where no formal reporting structures exist
Articulating in writing (actual papers, not slides) key issues and strategic initiatives for senior leadership
Acting as a thought and business leader in the field of cybersecurity, supply chain risk management, and supply chain operations

A day in the life

You are at the intersection of the Venn diagram for security, operations, and risk management, and thus work with a variety of different stakeholders. You will primarily focus on addressing supply chain security and risk concerns for UK-based public sector customers to allow the supply chain to operate smoothly, but the team supports our global footprint and you will collaborate with international peers to drive standardization and scalable practices across the global supply chain.

About The Team

Our team has the greatest end-to-end view and understanding of AWS's supply chain and sits at the center of the Venn diagram of supply chain security, operations, and risk management. We build bridges with both internal and external customers across those different disciplines to find the right balance between them.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Experience working with large, complex data sets

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with AWS data warehouse and reporting technologies like Redshift, Athena, S3, etc.
Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Workplace Health & Safety, AMZL NA
jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company, to be the best employer, and to be the safest place to work on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented and driven people. If you'd like to help us build that place, this is your chance to make history.

One focus area of the North America Amazon Logistics (AMZL) network is to provide tools, resources, and environments that support safe, efficient, and healthy behaviors and encourage employees to proactively manage their health and wellbeing. To support this focus area, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative person to serve as a Program Manager for AMZL WHS to build and execute programs that create a safe workplace and build a world-class safety culture in the midst of Amazon’s growth. In this role, you will dive deep into Operations processes; identify risks through data and first-hand experience; build and execute programs, and improve processes to eliminate risks; and influence Operations to sustain a culture of safety. This role will focus on coordinating and leading large, strategic projects within AMZL and will be strongly focused on injury and accident prevention as well as improvements across health, safety and wellness.

The WHS Program Manager role will challenge you to push boundaries and lead transformative innovation while having the autonomy to make rapid data-driven decisions and invent on behalf of Operators (operation leaders) and Team Members. In this role, you will work cross-functionally with members from various teams, including Operations; Human Resources, Procurement, Finance, WHS, Reliability, Engineering and Maintenance, Finance and OpEx to deploy solutions at scale. This role calls for an individual who is technically smart to gain credibility with customers and stakeholders at various levels of the organization.

The role will report into the Senior Manager, Strategic Initiatives for AMZL WHS and work collaboratively with other partners across all Amazon BUs and regional geographies to provide innovative solutions across our business. This role is based out of the Seattle, WA, Arlington, VA, or Nashville, TN corporate locations and will require 25% travel to support project deployments, factory acceptance tests (FATs), strategy meetings, and for process improvement Kaizen events.

The ideal candidate has an obsession for customers and a strong interest in building innovative solutions; must have proven analytical capabilities (including ability to deep dive, identify root causes and permanently eliminate hazards and risks); and can thrive in a fast-paced environment with exceptional communication and project management skills. The ideal candidate must have sound judgment, compassion, and interpersonal skills with the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues in many areas across the company.

Key job responsibilities

Develop, review, approve, coordinate, and lead large, strategic projects / programs within Amazon Business Units (BUs) and across different geographies.

Build relationships and partner across many organizations to build and execute on new initiatives and roadmaps each year.

Work and collaborate with stakeholders and partners to align on project /program goals and resources.

Coordinate a portfolio of programs / projects from inception to delivery.

Define and implement metrics to measure and communicate program achievements.

Compile, manage and report on weekly project metrics and be responsible for leading many high profile meetings to align on project requirements.

Communicate the overall program roadmap and provide periodic status updates to the stakeholders, and presenting programs / projects to senior leadership on a regular basis.

Provide programs decision support, insights and recommendations through data gathering and information analyzing.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree, or Master's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
2+ years of driving process improvements experience

jobs.title: Sr Technical Program Manager, AWS Supply Chain Enablement & Risk Management
jobs.description:
Description

In this role, you will be part of the team that ensures AWS's supply chain can deliver the datacenter racks, servers, and networking equipment to our datacenters across the globe. The rest of the supply chain looks to us to clear strategic problems and "enable" them to focus on execution. We are the jack-of-all-trades with the best understanding of how the entire end-to-end supply chain works and how to help it run better.

This is a high-judgment role, where you will represent the AWS supply chain during engagements with public sector customers, and must be able to translate customer and regulatory requirements into actionable deliverables, determine what is a true requirement versus a nice-to-have, and understand how to find the balance between cybersecurity and business objectives.

The ideal candidate is a technically savvy individual leader, capable of leveraging AWS's internal business and artificial intelligence tool to gather data and identify risks before they become problems, as well as interact with both internal and external senior leaders to gain support for new initiatives and obtain consensus with AWS customers.

You will be responsible for identifying, creating, and delivering on your initiatives and must have both excellent interpersonal and writing skills to work across myriad teams in the supply chain, security, and legal organizations to deliver results in an ambiguous operating environment. It will be your responsibility to ensure the supply chain delivers on our security and risk management commitments to our customers, as well as make sure region build and operational teams are able to get the infrastructure hardware they need when they need it.

This position requires that the selected candidate already be a UK citizen and, after starting, obtain the commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities

Driving consensus and standardization for acceptable levels of risk and best practices across supply chain operations
Developing technical solutions that drive automation at scale to ensure datacenter infrastructure is delivered on-time, in-full
Proactively working with other organizations to anticipate gaps between teams, processes, and system architectures, influencing where no formal reporting structures exist
Articulating in writing (actual papers, not slides) key issues and strategic initiatives for senior leadership
Acting as a thought and business leader in the field of cybersecurity, supply chain risk management, and supply chain operations

A day in the life

You are at the intersection of the Venn diagram for security, operations, and risk management, and thus work with a variety of different stakeholders. You will primarily focus on addressing supply chain security and risk concerns for UK-based public sector customers to allow the supply chain to operate smoothly, but the team supports our global footprint and you will collaborate with international peers to drive standardization and scalable practices across the global supply chain.

About The Team

Our team has the greatest end-to-end view and understanding of AWS's supply chain and sits at the center of the Venn diagram of supply chain security, operations, and risk management. We build bridges with both internal and external customers across those different disciplines to find the right balance between them.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Experience working with large, complex data sets

Experience with AWS data warehouse and reporting technologies like Redshift, Athena, S3, etc.
Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages

Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.

In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply

If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company, to be the best employer, and to be the safest place to work on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented and driven people. If you'd like to help us build that place, this is your chance to make history.

One focus area of the North America Amazon Logistics (AMZL) network is to provide tools, resources, and environments that support safe, efficient, and healthy behaviors and encourage employees to proactively manage their health and wellbeing. To support this focus area, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative person to serve as a Program Manager for AMZL WHS to build and execute programs that create a safe workplace and build a world-class safety culture in the midst of Amazon’s growth. In this role, you will dive deep into Operations processes; identify risks through data and first-hand experience; build and execute programs, and improve processes to eliminate risks; and influence Operations to sustain a culture of safety. This role will focus on coordinating and leading large, strategic projects within AMZL and will be strongly focused on injury and accident prevention as well as improvements across health, safety and wellness.

The WHS Program Manager role will challenge you to push boundaries and lead transformative innovation while having the autonomy to make rapid data-driven decisions and invent on behalf of Operators (operation leaders) and Team Members. In this role, you will work cross-functionally with members from various teams, including Operations; Human Resources, Procurement, Finance, WHS, Reliability, Engineering and Maintenance, Finance and OpEx to deploy solutions at scale. This role calls for an individual who is technically smart to gain credibility with customers and stakeholders at various levels of the organization.

The role will report into the Senior Manager, Strategic Initiatives for AMZL WHS and work collaboratively with other partners across all Amazon BUs and regional geographies to provide innovative solutions across our business. This role is based out of the Seattle, WA, Arlington, VA, or Nashville, TN corporate locations and will require 25% travel to support project deployments, factory acceptance tests (FATs), strategy meetings, and for process improvement Kaizen events.

The ideal candidate has an obsession for customers and a strong interest in building innovative solutions; must have proven analytical capabilities (including ability to deep dive, identify root causes and permanently eliminate hazards and risks); and can thrive in a fast-paced environment with exceptional communication and project management skills. The ideal candidate must have sound judgment, compassion, and interpersonal skills with the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues in many areas across the company.

Key job responsibilities

Develop, review, approve, coordinate, and lead large, strategic projects / programs within Amazon Business Units (BUs) and across different geographies.

Build relationships and partner across many organizations to build and execute on new initiatives and roadmaps each year.

Work and collaborate with stakeholders and partners to align on project /program goals and resources.

Coordinate a portfolio of programs / projects from inception to delivery.

Define and implement metrics to measure and communicate program achievements.

Compile, manage and report on weekly project metrics and be responsible for leading many high profile meetings to align on project requirements.

Communicate the overall program roadmap and provide periodic status updates to the stakeholders, and presenting programs / projects to senior leadership on a regular basis.

Provide programs decision support, insights and recommendations through data gathering and information analyzing.

Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree, or Master's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
2+ years of driving process improvements experience

jobs.description:
THE ROLE

As our Asset Operations Analyst
, you'll ensure regulatory, contractual, and commercial compliance across a dedicated portfolio — working closely with technical, finance, and ESG teams to keep assets compliant, profitable, and aligned with our standards.

This role plays a key part in protecting asset value and supporting WiseEnergy
's mission of enabling the global transition to clean energy.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the management of commercial contracts (PPAs, SPAs, leases, EPC and O&M contracts, market representation agreements)
Oversee the full contract lifecycle, from onboarding new sites to integrating key terms into our systems
Ensure compliance with environmental regulations and licensing requirements
Prepare revenue budgets, forecasts, and support asset operating plans
Manage insurance renewals, claims, and landowner relationships
Support ESG compliance and reporting activities
Collaborate cross-functionally with technical and finance teams
Drive continuous improvement of contract management processes and tools

Skills & Competencies

To be successful in this role, you will demonstrate:

Excellent communication and presentation skills (in English and Italian) - you must be able to organize your thoughts in a way that others find clear and compelling. You will be expected to put together well-written, grammatically correct emails, presentations and other communications. When communicating verbally – whether over the phone, on video calls, in person or in meetings – you will need to be articulate and engaging.
Time management & prioritization skills - the ability to effectively manage yourself and your workload is critical.
Fast Learner – Our US portfolio spans multiple states (New York, Virginia and North Carolina) with differing PPAs and regulatory requirements in each. Being able to quickly digest, learn and adapt to these differing challenges is key
Flexibility - being an effective team player means being flexible in your approach and open to getting involved with new things, even if they are not spelt out in your job description.
Delivery focus – it may sound obvious, but the ability to proactively churn through work at pace and deliver quality outputs really matters.
IT literacy - you need to be comfortable with IT systems and working with data, particularly Excel.
Passion for our mission ‘to generate a more sustainable future by leading the transition to clean energy.
Our values: be a leader, build trust, be responsible, be innovative and ‘bring your alpha’.

Experience & Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Law, Economics, Engineering, or related field
2–3 years' experience in a similar role, ideally within renewable energy
Strong background in regulatory, property, and contract management
Fluent English and Italian (mandatory); Spanish or Portuguese is a plus
Advanced Microsoft Office skills (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and organisational skills

What We Offer

A busy role in a supportive team, with plenty of opportunities to learn
International scope – we operate in over 8 countries

€10 meal vouchers (Ticket Restaurant)

Annual discretionary bonus.

As a Business Analyst on the Payment Acceptance & Experience Marketing team you will own analytics for our emerging business efforts.

jobs.description:
Description

The IDC Analytics team is looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Business Analyst I to join our team and contribute to the analytics foundation that powers AWS Marketing’s demand generation engine. In this entry-level role, you will execute analyses, build dashboards, and support the data pipelines that underpin campaign performance reporting across the IDC organization. You will work closely with senior analysts and marketing stakeholders to deliver accurate, timely reporting while developing your analytical skills in a fast-paced, data-rich environment. This is an ideal opportunity for someone early in their career who is passionate about turning raw data into actionable insights, enjoys hands-on SQL and dashboard work, and wants to grow their craft within one of the most analytically driven marketing teams at AWS.

Key job responsibilities

Execute analytical requests from marketing stakeholders, delivering accurate data pulls, ad-hoc analyses, and structured summaries
Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reports in QuickSight to support campaign performance tracking and operational visibility
Write SQL queries against Redshift to extract and transform marketing data for reporting and analysis
Perform data quality checks and validation to ensure accuracy and consistency across reporting pipelines
Support senior analysts in developing measurement frameworks, attribution analyses, and funnel reporting
Collaborate with data engineering to troubleshoot ETL pipeline issues and improve data reliability
Use AI tools (such as Kiro IDE, Amazon Quick, and MCP-based assistants) to accelerate data exploration, query generation, and reporting workflows
Support the development of AI-powered automations for data validation and report generation, reducing manual turnaround times
Assist in gathering and documenting business requirements from marketing stakeholders, translating them into Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) used by D:SE (Data Science & Engineering) and S&O (Strategy & Operations) teams to build and enhance performance dashboards
Document analytical methodologies, query logic, and reporting processes in team knowledge bases
Prepare data summaries and visualizations for weekly and monthly business reviews

A day in the life

Your focus is turning marketing data into clear answers. Most mornings, you’ll check dashboards to see how campaigns perform, dig into anomalies, and share findings with the marketers running those campaigns before they even ask. You’ll write SQL against large datasets to deep dive and do root cause analysis - connecting top of funnel metrics to revenue impact. You’ll partner with teams to translate their questions into structured analytical plans, and use AI tools to automate reporting, validate data, and speed up your workflows. When something interesting surfaces, you won’t wait to be asked - you’ll bring it to the table.

About The Team

The Integrated Demand Center (IDC) is AWS Marketing’s unified function for planning, delivering, and measuring demand generation at scale. The IDC Analytics team sits within Demand Services, the shared services arm powering campaign execution and innovation. We generate actionable insights across the IDC — delivering analytics, custom reporting, and clear recommendations that help teams optimize performance, strengthen adoption, and accelerate revenue impact. Our work spans configuring dashboards, defining and monitoring delivery KPIs, translating business requirements into technical specifications, supporting steering reviews and QBRs, and partnering with marketers to transform complex data into data-driven decisions at strategic, tactical, and operational levels.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in mathematics, engineering, statistics, computer science or a related field
2+ years of Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables) experience
Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
Experience with SQL or ETL

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages
Experience using very large datasets
Experience in Online Advertising/Marketing/Sales/Digital Media

jobs.description:
Description

Alexa+ is Amazon's next-generation AI-powered personal assistant, built on large language models to deliver natural, conversational, and context-aware experiences for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. We are building new services and experiences for Alexa+ customers from the ground up, and we're looking for an experienced, generative AI-savvy Senior Technical Program Manager to help drive them to delivery.

In this role, you will lead complex, cross-functional programs that span multiple engineering teams building Tier-1 cloud services and real-time experiences for hundreds of millions of devices and customers. You'll turn ambiguous, large-scale technical challenges into clear roadmaps, drive execution across organizational boundaries, and ensure we deliver experiences that redefine what a personal assistant can do. You'll operate at the intersection of engineering and product — bringing structure to greenfield initiatives and keeping fast-moving teams aligned, unblocked, and shipping.

Why You'll Love It Here

Large-scale, high-visibility programs: You'll plan, lead, and orchestrate technically rich initiatives at a scale few programs encounter — coordinating across many teams to deliver solutions for our customers. And we don't just build AI products; we use generative AI extensively in our own planning and execution, keeping you at the forefront of the field.
High-impact, collaborative partners: Join a team of passionate engineers and product managers who support each other, share knowledge freely, and celebrate wins together — and who value the clarity and momentum a great TPM brings.
Greenfield opportunity: We're building from the ground up, giving you the chance to shape not just architecture and program, but the very mechanisms, processes, and delivery culture from day one.
World-changing impact: The programs you drive will directly shape how hundreds of millions of customers interact with their personal assistant every day.

Key job responsibilities

Own and drive end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-organizational technical programs — from ambiguous concept through launch and operation — including requirements, technical design, planning, risk mitigation, and stakeholder communication.
Contribute to annual and quarterly planning cycles, translating organizational strategy into actionable program plans.
Partner cross-functionally with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to align priorities, make trade-off decisions, and communicate program status to senior leadership.
Establish and improve mechanisms — status reporting, operational reviews, launch readiness, and audit metrics — that create visibility and explain variance against goals.
Drive engineering and operational excellence by embedding quality, reliability, and launch-readiness standards into program planning and execution.
Champion the use of generative AI both in the experiences we ship and in our own program and engineering practices to accelerate time to market.

About The Team

The Alexa Connected Devices team designs, builds, and operates the core horizontal services that power Alexa — the world's largest IoT installation and most capable, efficient, and trusted AI assistant. We deliver the capabilities that let Alexa connect, discover, set up, and manage over 1 billion connected endpoints across Echo, Fire TV, Smart Home, Mobile, and Apps.

Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

Alexa+ is Amazon's next-generation AI-powered personal assistant, built on large language models to deliver natural, conversational, and context-aware experiences for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. We are building new services and experiences for Alexa+ customers from the ground up, and we're looking for an experienced, generative AI-savvy Senior Technical Program Manager to help drive them to delivery.

In this role, you will lead complex, cross-functional programs that span multiple engineering teams building Tier-1 cloud services and real-time experiences for hundreds of millions of devices and customers. You'll turn ambiguous, large-scale technical challenges into clear roadmaps, drive execution across organizational boundaries, and ensure we deliver experiences that redefine what a personal assistant can do. You'll operate at the intersection of engineering and product — bringing structure to greenfield initiatives and keeping fast-moving teams aligned, unblocked, and shipping.

Why You'll Love It Here

Large-scale, high-visibility programs: You'll plan, lead, and orchestrate technically rich initiatives at a scale few programs encounter — coordinating across many teams to deliver solutions for our customers. And we don't just build AI products; we use generative AI extensively in our own planning and execution, keeping you at the forefront of the field.
High-impact, collaborative partners: Join a team of passionate engineers and product managers who support each other, share knowledge freely, and celebrate wins together — and who value the clarity and momentum a great TPM brings.
Greenfield opportunity: We're building from the ground up, giving you the chance to shape not just architecture and program, but the very mechanisms, processes, and delivery culture from day one.
World-changing impact: The programs you drive will directly shape how hundreds of millions of customers interact with their personal assistant every day.

Own and drive end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-organizational technical programs — from ambiguous concept through launch and operation — including requirements, technical design, planning, risk mitigation, and stakeholder communication.

Champion the use of generative AI both in the experiences we ship and in our own program and engineering practices to accelerate time to market.

About The Team

The Alexa Connected Devices team designs, builds, and operates the core horizontal services that power Alexa — the world's largest IoT installation and most capable, efficient, and trusted AI assistant. jobs.title: Sr. Worldwide Program Manager, Data & AI GTM
jobs.description:
Description

This isn't your typical program management role. You'll be the person who ensures the infrastructure behind AWS's Data & AI sales plays actually works, and works well. That means holding a high bar on sales play templates, bill of materials quality, reporting, and content management so that everything the AWS sales field touches is accurate, up-to-date, and ready to drive impact. You'll own and continuously improve the knowledge base of sales plays, reusable content, and industry use cases that enables our sellers, and the agentic experiences that assist them, to help customers faster and more effectively. Think of this role as running the center of excellence for Data & AI sales plays: setting the standard, maintaining the system, and making sure what we put in front of AWS field teams and assistance agents is always sharp and current.

You'll drive global GTM initiatives from the ground up, identifying where the biggest opportunities are, packaging them into repeatable motions, and making sure they land with impact across regions and industries. If a sales team in financial services needs a sharper AI use case to unlock a deal, or if healthcare needs a data play that resonates with CIOs, that's your infrastructure and content showing up in the field.

What makes this role different is the scope and the leverage. You're not supporting one team or one product. You're shaping how AWS's entire Data & AI story gets organized, maintained, and delivered across the globe. You'll work across product, business development, solutions architecture, marketing, sales, and partner teams to make that happen, and you'll see your impact in real numbers: pipeline created, deals accelerated, revenue driven.

If you like building systems that scale, thrive in ambiguity, and want to work at the intersection of program rigor and GTM execution in one of the fastest-moving spaces in tech, this is the job.

Key job responsibilities

Serve as the center of excellence for Data & AI sales plays, setting and enforcing standards for sales play templates, completion, bills of materials, use case documentation, content management, and quality across the portfolio
Own and continuously improve the knowledge base of sales plays, reusable content, and industry use cases that enables our sales field and assistance agents to help customers more effectively
Influence cross-functional teams to design, build, and scale repeatable sales plays while driving a high bar for bills of materials that directly address friction points in the customer sales cycle, delivered through both traditional methods and agentic experiences
Manage sales play and use case reporting, tracking performance metrics like pipeline generated, sales acceleration, and win/revenue realization rates, and continuously iterating based on what the data and anecdotes tell you
Help develop industry-focused use cases (e.g., financial services, healthcare, manufacturing) that show customers exactly how AWS Data & AI solves their specific challenges
Partner cross-functionally with product, solutions architecture, marketing, sales, and partner teams to ensure GTM initiatives are aligned, resourced, and landing with impact across regions
Ensure the infrastructure of sales acceleration content is accurate, current, and structured to power both human sellers and agentic experiences at scale
Drive executive-level alignment on GTM priorities, making the case for where to invest and ensuring stakeholders across the business are rowing in the same direction

A day in the life

Your morning might start with a call reviewing pipeline data to see which sales plays are gaining traction and which need retooling. By mid-morning, you're in a working session with product and marketing teams, pressure-testing a new set of industry use case for financial services before it goes live to the field. After lunch, you're collaborating with a specialist sales leader in Australia who's seeing friction in a deal cycle and needs a sharper bill of materials — and you're figuring out how to deliver it both through traditional enablement channels and agentic experiences. Late afternoon, you're pulling together an executive memo that makes the case for doubling down on a GTM motion that's outperforming expectations. No two days look the same, but the throughline is always the same: connecting strategy to execution and making sure what you build actually moves numbers.

About The Team

We're a worldwide team that sits at the crossroads of AWS's Data & AI portfolio, working across categories rather than within a single product lane. Our job is to take everything AWS offers in the Data & AI space and package it into GTM sales motions that are clear, compelling, and easy for the AWS field to execute. That means driving campaigns, sales plays, field activations, and sales incentives, and doing it in close partnership with marketing, product, business development, and solutions architecture teams. We connect a lot of dots so that when a sales play lands in the hands of field teams anywhere in the world, it's sharp, complete, and ready to drive pipeline. If you like working horizontally across big organizations and turning complexity into simplicity, you'll feel right at home here.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
Knowledge of general AI tools

Preferred Qualifications

2+ years of driving process improvements experience
Experience driving global sales enablement programs that equip field teams with the tools, messaging, and content they need to execute effectively
Experience leading or contributing to organizational transformation efforts where you've helped teams adopt new ways of working, shift mindsets, or stand up entirely new operating models

This position is located in the Department of General Services (DGS). The mission of DGS is to manage the capital improvement and construction program for District government facilities; acquire (by purchase or lease) real property for use by the District government, managing space in buildings and adjacent areas operated and leased by the District government; provide building services for facilities owned and occupied by the District government, including engineering services, custodial services, security services, energy conservation, utilities management, maintenance, inspection and planning and repairs and non-structural improvements; and, dispose of District real and personal property through sales, leases, or other authorized methods.

Independently designs and executes studies to evaluate the productivity and cost-effectiveness of the department's HVAC operations (such as comparing reactive repairs against preventive maintenance schedules). Turn the most promising opportunities into action and clear customer value. Support roadmap conversations with enterprise clients, build the business case, and work cross-functionally with engineering, design, and other teams to bring initiatives to life.
Optimize.
Use A/B tests, business and product metrics, and ongoing analysis to understand what works and what doesn’t. Scale successful initiatives, improve existing ones, and use each result to inform the next cycle of discovery and execution.

What we look for
Reasoning ability.
Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Drive.
You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Team spirit.
You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English.
You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offer
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams.
You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
An exceptional opportunity for growth.
We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
All. These. Benefits.
Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount.
Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.

Commitment & contract

Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location

Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process

In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply

If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Project Manager
jobs.description:
About OpenLoop

OpenLoop was co-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go-to-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states.

About The Role

OpenLoop’s mission is to bring care anywhere by powering telehealth solutions at scale. Every customer launch requires multiple OpenLoop and customer teams to deliver interdependent work. As a Technical Project Manager, you will provide the project-management control system that connects that work. You will manage a portfolio of concurrent customer implementations and personally lead project delivery for strategic accounts from approved solution through launch and stabilization. Your job is to ensure that the implementation work has clear ownership, across an integrated plan and a credible forecast.

What You’ll Do

Manage an assigned portfolio of concurrent customer implementations, maintaining accurate visibility into stage, forecast, milestones, risks, dependencies and upcoming decisions.
Personally project-manage OpenLoop’s largest or most complex strategic account implementation plans.
Convert approved scope and functional workplans into one integrated project plan with milestones, accountable owners, dependencies, decision dates, stage gates and acceptance evidence.
Establish and control the critical path, distinguishing launch-critical work from activity that can run in parallel.
Run implementation governance: kickoff, workstream reviews, project status, risk and decision reviews, readiness gates and executive steering committees.
Establish a credible baseline and update the forecast when scope, assumptions, dependencies or capacity change.
Own the change-control process, ensuring schedule, resource and launch impact is understood before new work enters the plan.
Identify material risks early and drive mitigation or recovery plans with named owners and deadlines.
Track customer, vendor and internal dependencies through resolution rather than merely documenting them.
Escalate with evidence, options, a recommendation and a decision deadline.
Lead implementation-specific client communication while partnering with the CSM on the broader relationship and commercial context.
Coordinate UAT planning, including participants, schedule, entry and exit criteria, defect triage, retesting and sign-off tracking.
Maintain the launch-readiness view and ensure technical, operational, clinical and customer owners provide the required evidence and approvals.
Facilitate evidence-based go/no-go discussions without substituting your judgment for technical or functional sign-off.
Coordinate launch, stabilization, closure and a clean transition to Customer Success and Support.
Surface shared-resource conflicts and upcoming demand to the Director with sequencing options and a recommendation; do not independently assign technical resources.
Keep the project-management system current as the source of truth across assigned accounts.
Identify recurring portfolio problems and recommend improvements to PMO playbooks, stage gates and templates.

Who You Are

A project manager first. Your value comes from creating control, accountability and predictability—not from performing the implementation yourself.
Able to manage several implementations while still going deep enough to lead a strategic account under pressure.
Rigorous about critical paths, baselines, forecasts, scope, decisions and dependencies.
Direct with clients. You communicate risk before a date has already been missed.
Technically fluent without being technically performative. You know which questions to ask and who must answer them.
Comfortable creating accountability across teams that do not report to you.
Strong with executives, project teams, engineers, operators and customer stakeholders.
Disciplined about maintaining the shared source of truth.
Pragmatic about process: detailed enough to drive decisions, light enough that teams use it.
Clear about decision rights and unwilling to quietly absorb responsibilities that belong elsewhere.

Required Qualifications

5+ years in project or program management within B2B software, healthcare technology, platforms or technology-enabled services.
Direct project-management ownership of external customer implementations from post-sale handoff through launch.
Experience managing multiple concurrent implementations or a genuinely complex, multi-workstream strategic account.
Strong experience with integrated planning, critical-path management, RAID management, change control and delivery forecasting.
Experience leading client project governance and executive steering committees.
Experience coordinating UAT, defect triage, launch readiness, cutover and stabilization.
Project-management-level fluency across APIs, integrations, data flows, identity, environments, security reviews and testing dependencies.
Experience partnering with dedicated implementation engineers, technical consultants or solution architects without assuming their responsibilities.
Strong written and verbal executive communication.
High data discipline in project-management and portfolio-reporting systems.

Preferred Qualifications

Healthcare, digital health, virtual care or another regulated-industry background.
Experience with EMR or clinical-workflow implementations.
Experience coordinating pharmacy, lab, clinician-network, credentialing, licensing or multi-state operational dependencies.
Experience in a professional-services or client-delivery environment with clear separation between project managers and technical implementers.
Experience working within tiered delivery models.
PMP, PgMP or equivalent training; evidence of delivery judgment matters more than certification.

Our Benefits

In addition, for salaried positions you would also be eligible for:

Medical, Dental, and Vision plans
Flexible Spending/Health Savings Accounts
Flexible PTO
401(k) + Company Match
Life Insurance, Pet insurance, and more

Our Company

We have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work.

Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Bidgely (which means "electricity" in Hindi) is a Vertical AI company built for the utility industry, delivering appliance-level intelligence for every customer, grid asset, and hour of the year through our UtilityAI™ Platform. We're accelerating a clean energy future by giving utilities and their customers the ability to make smarter, data-driven energy decisions.

Bidgely's platform is connected to 38M+ meters across 45+ utility deployments and is backed by over 20 patents. Our approach combines patented disaggregation science, generative AI for natural-language insight, and agentic AI for autonomous operations — giving utilities a level of individual-customer intelligence and grid insights that horizontal AI and legacy analytics platforms can't match.

Bidgely has been named #7 in Applied AI on Fast Company's list of Most Innovative Companies in the World and recognized as a Utility Analytics Leader by Guidehouse.

What We Do

Powered by our unique patented technology, Bidgely's UtilityAI™ Platform transforms multiple dimensions of utility data — such as energy consumption, demographics, and customer interactions — into deeply accurate and actionable consumer energy insights. We leverage these insights to empower each customer with personalized recommendations tailored to their individual personality and lifestyle, usage attributes, behavioral patterns, purchase propensity and beyond.

The same technology that powers Bidgely's customer suite also enables a set of powerful grid applications. From a distributed energy resources (DER) and grid edge perspective, Bidgely is accelerating utility innovation with data-driven solutions for solar PVs, electric vehicle (EV) detection, EV behavioral load shifting and managed charging, load forecasting, grid analytics, and rate designs. Bidgely's UtilityAI™ energy analytics platform provides deep visibility into generation and consumption for better peak load shaping and grid planning and delivers targeted recommendations for new value-added products and services.

How You Fit In

The Senior Technical Program Manager (STPM) owns Bidgely's largest and most technically and commercially complex utility engagements, combining the roles of technical consultant, functional consultant, and project manager. The STPM also acts as a delivery and practice leader for the broader Customer Onboarding team. The STPM works closely with a dedicated delivery team on the technical build, with R&D and Product Management on platform direction, and with Systems Integrator partners on multi-party engagements — while owning the customer relationship, executive stakeholder management, and program outcomes. The STPM reports into the Director, Customer Onboarding and is part of Bidgely's Customer Onboarding team.

Core responsibilities span the following areas:

Project Management

Be the face of Bidgely for the customer during the implementation phase, owning the relationship, and being an advocate for them internally
Manage Bidgely's largest and most complex utility implementations end to end from Onboarding to Launch, leading cross-functional teams across Delivery, Engineering, Product, and Sales
Oversee project financials — including cost tracking, budget, and margin — for assigned engagements
Contribute to contract reviews for new deals and change orders
Represent the Onboarding team in sales presentations as needed
Develop and apply a deep understanding of energy markets and customer behaviors to help Bidgely customers take full advantage of the technology

Technology Implementation

Own the overall solution design and development for Bidgely's most complex utility customers, working with our global engineering team — including requirement analysis, customer journey scope discussion, data integration, design, solution architecture, implementation, delivery, and customer-facing technical issue resolution
Be the product expert who collaborates with utility customers to understand requirements, map them to product features, and finalize product customizations and changes
Manage project deliverables, ensuring on-time, high-quality delivery through a hands-on approach
Produce technical and product documents that clearly define customer requirements and solution design in collaboration with the customer's IT and business teams
Partner with Bidgely R&D and Product Management to design new platform functionality and implementation tooling, informed by patterns observed across the most complex customer implementations

Practice Leadership

Mentor and provide delivery and technical guidance to colleagues
Own executive-level customer relationships for high-visibility engagements
Develop proposals and statements of work for new and expanding engagements
Identify and help scope account expansion opportunities during delivery
Represent Customer Onboarding in quarterly business reviews (QBRs)
Work with Systems Integrator (SI) partners to plan and execute complex, multi-party implementations
Train Bidgely, SI, and customer teams on Bidgely's project methodology and product capabilities
Develop internal tools and processes that improve delivery quality and reduce implementation timelines
Support hiring and interviewing for the broader TPM team

Skills And Qualifications

Required Qualifications

7-11 years of software integration project experience at a SaaS company, or experience in a top-tier systems integration consulting firm and/or delivering enterprise solutions at a fast-paced start-up
Track record of successfully delivering complex, cross-functional implementations for large, high-touch enterprise customers, ideally with ACV of $500K+
Experience as the primary point of contact for enterprise customers, including designing and deploying solution architecture in a customer-facing role
Experience working with globally dispersed customers and teams
Experience with Agile software development methodologies and cloud-based B2B implementations
Comfortable creating and tracking project plans, risks, and status reports via Wrike, Smartsheets, Jira, or similar cloud project management tools
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent written and verbal communication and the ability to translate complex technical issues for non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop less experienced team members
Highly organized, collaborative, and proactive, with a customer-first mentality

Preferred Qualifications

Working knowledge of SQL, Python, REST APIs, or data transformation tools, with a hands-on aptitude for applying them directly
Passion for or experience within the energy or energy efficiency sector
PMP certification

What You Get

Growth Potential: Build your career at a fast-scaling company at the forefront of AI-driven energy innovation
Collaborative Environment: Work with a passionate team united by the goal of a clean energy future
Leading Technology: Gain hands-on exposure to the AI, machine learning, and data platforms shaping the future of the utility industry

Benefits

Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance from day one
HSA, FSA, and DCFSA plans
401(k) plan
Flexible paid time off
Annual wellness stipend
Annual professional development stipend
Paid parental leave
Mental health and wellness resources for you and your family

Other Perks

Employee Discounts: Preferred pricing on entertainment, technology, and insurance products
Mentorship: Access to mentorship from experienced industry leaders
Flexible Work Arrangements: Remote-friendly scheduling built around how you work best
Community Service Days: Paid time to volunteer for causes you care about

Location

Remote within the US with up to 15% travel

Salary And Compensation

The base salary ranges from $135,000-$160,000 DOE. This role may also be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus and equity, subject to company policy and role level.

In accordance with the California Equal Pay and Pay Transparency laws, the approximate annual base compensation range is listed above. The actual offer, reflecting the total compensation package and benefits, will be determined by a number of factors including the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity among our team.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Equal Opportunity

At Bidgely we're on a mission to make a difference and build a workplace where every unique voice is heard and celebrated. Here, we believe that celebrating the unique backgrounds, perspectives and abilities of every employee makes an impact not only for our company internally but also for our clients, customers and community.

We are an equal opportunity employer and believe that the inclusive atmosphere we build together will enable every person to grow, contribute and thrive. Our hiring decisions are based on your skills, talent, and passion – not on your background, gender, race, age, or the quirky way you dance at office parties.

Job Summary

As a Senior Technical Program Manager supporting the Data & Analytics organization, you will lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex, cross-functional data initiatives that enable enterprise reporting, analytics, AI, governance, and business decision-making.

You will partner closely with Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Analytics, AI, Product, Security, Infrastructure, application teams, implementation partners, and business stakeholders to deliver strategic initiatives spanning enterprise data platforms, data products, governance capabilities, migration efforts, and operational data services.

We are seeking a technically fluent, outcome-oriented program leader who can:

Facilitate technical working sessions with engineers, architects, product leaders, and business stakeholders.
Understand data architectures, data flows, lineage, integration patterns, and platform dependencies at a working level.
Ask probing, technically informed questions; challenge assumptions; and surface hidden delivery risks.
Establish clarity and accountability across complex stakeholder groups without direct authority.
Translate technical complexity, trade-offs, and decisions into clear executive communications.
Drive execution discipline across large, multi-year initiatives from planning through adoption and value realization.

The ideal candidate combines strong program management rigor with hands-on experience supporting enterprise data ecosystems and transformational delivery efforts.

The initial assignment will lead a cross-functional remediation program addressing data privacy, data retention, and test data management, including the governance, process, technology, and operational changes required to establish sustainable compliance and controls.

location: Newport Beach, California

job type: Solutions

salary: $80 - 90 per hour

work hours: 8am to 5pm

education: Bachelors
