jobs.title: AI Security Analyst
jobs.description:
It's a new day with a new opportunity at 8am!

About the role:

The AI Security Analyst is a hybrid role combining security operations monitoring with AI-specific risk management and governance support. The role focuses on identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks associated with AI use, particularly generative AI, LLMs, and agentic systems, across internal tools and customer-facing platforms, while contributing to traditional security monitoring. The role does not involve building or training AI models; it secures how AI is deployed, governed, monitored, and used.

Location: Czech Republic (Remote). Working hours for this role are aligned to U.S. Central Time (Austin) core business hours to ensure real-time collaboration with the U.S.-based security leadership and compliance team.

This role is hired through an Employer of Record (EOR) partner in the Czech Republic.

About us:

8am builds software that helps professionals run stronger businesses. Our platform powers payments, client experience, and operational workflows for legal, accounting, and other service-based businesses. U.S. based professionals count on our purpose-built solutions to simplify operations, ensure compliance, and fuel profitable growth, so they can focus on their clients and do more of the work that matters.

More than 250,000 professionals across the U.S. rely on our products every day. As we continue to grow, we're investing in the next generation of our platform and are looking for experienced engineers who want to help shape its future.

What you'll do:

AI security and risk management:
Identify and mitigate AI-specific threats: prompt injection, jailbreaking and adversarial inputs, sensitive information disclosure, insecure output handling and excessive agency, model misuse and overreliance, and supply chain vulnerabilities in third-party AI services and models.
AI use-case review:
Triage and risk-assess proposed AI use cases with Engineering, Product, Legal, and Privacy before production deployment; recommend controls and document decisions.
Agentic governance support:
Support the operation of the company's agentic-work governance model: autonomy classification reviews, agent activity monitoring, and evidence collection for governance reviews.
Vendor and model review:
Evaluate third-party AI vendors, model providers, and AI-enabled features for security posture and data handling; maintain the approved-provider view.
Security operations and monitoring:
Perform SOC-style monitoring, alert triage, and investigation across cloud, application, and AI-enabled systems, including AI API usage and data flows; enhance detection rules and logging for AI-specific activity.
Compliance and governance support:
Support audit readiness for SOC 2 and PCI DSS and alignment with emerging AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, OWASP LLM Top 10, ISO/IEC 42001 as the program matures); document AI security controls and risk assessments.
Incident support:
Support AI-related incident response, investigation, and post-incident analysis.

About you:

3+ years in security operations, security analysis, or GRC with hands-on technical exposure.
Working understanding of LLM-specific threat classes (OWASP LLM Top 10) and AI risk frameworks (NIST AI RMF).
Ability to read logs, write basic queries and scripts, and investigate independently.
Strong written English and documentation discipline; comfortable in a distributed team.
Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools and technologies to improve workflows, enhance decision-making, or drive innovation.
This position is preferably based in Brno, Czech Republic

Bonus points:

Experience monitoring or governing agentic AI systems, MCP integrations, or AI developer tooling.
Fintech, legal-tech, or other regulated-industry background.

Additional Information

The monthly gross salary range for this position is CZK 75,000 to CZK 140,000. 8am is committed to fair, objective, and non-discriminatory compensation, and actual pay may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and education.

Founding Team Impact:
Be a founding engineer of our new Brno R&D hub. After a brief 1-6 month integration with U.S. based teams, you will help form fully autonomous, locally-led squads with clear paths to Staff and leadership roles
Drive our "AI-First" Transformation:
We are building a secure, massive-scale "Unified AI Platform". Depending on your squad, you will either help architect this core infrastructure (LLM routing, RAG, agent orchestration) or build directly on top of it.
Build the Next Generation of Our Platform:
Help shape the systems powering products used by more than 250,000 professionals. You'll work on complex platform capabilities across payments, workflow automation, and AI-powered features as we expand into new professional service markets.

Benefits and Perks

We offer a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support your life in the Czech Republic while giving you access to global opportunities:

Performance bonus opportunities
and employee referral rewards

and 13 paid public holidays aligned with the Czech calendar

in line with Czech regulations, plus additional paid paternity leave from 8am
Full statutory benefits
, including public health insurance, social security, pension, and work accident coverage

Grow Your Career

Clear growth paths, regular feedback, and opportunities for advancement

International company environment
with collaboration across Europe and the U.S.

High-quality company swag and programs focused on wellness, learning, and connection

Experience comes in many forms and ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where we continue to learn from each other is an integral part of our culture. We are committed to creating a welcoming and transparent environment for all that embraces those differences through education, equal access to opportunities and information, inclusionary programs, and community outreach.

jobs.description:
Overview

Western Digital is entering a new chapter. Following our spin-off of SanDisk, we are stepping into our future as an independent deep-tech company, one built on decades of engineering breakthroughs and pointed squarely at the biggest technological frontiers of our time.

We are a company of physicists, materials scientists, AI researchers, and engineers. We work at the frontier of magnetics, photonics, nanofabrication, and machine learning - disciplines most people never encounter, solving problems most people don't know exist. Our teams hold one of the largest intellectual property banks in Silicon Valley, and our labs are staffed with hundreds of PhDs who've spent their careers pushing what's physically possible.

Most folks know us as a data storage company, powering data centers, hyperscale clouds, and AI systems that define the modern economy. HDD is the backbone of the AI economy and the most scalable, cost-efficient way to store the world's data - and we're building its future. But it's only part of the story. In the past, our technology has helped put a man on the moon and captured the first-ever picture of a black hole. The next generation of what we are building will shape robotics, quantum computing, space systems, personalized medicine, autonomous vehicles, and more. We are entering the most ambitious phase of our company's history. As AI reshapes every industry and every workload, the world needs more data infrastructure, better materials science, and deeper engineering talent than ever before. That's what we do. That's what we've always done. And we're just getting started.

Western Digital's Strategy & Corporate Development team is the connective tissue bridging Western Digital's technology to the markets it will serve. We turn deep-tech capability into commercial impact, strengthening our position in the core HDD business, setting the company's long-term strategy, and executing the partnerships, investments, and acquisitions that shape what we build next.

If you want to work on problems that matter at the intersection of deep technology, business strategy, and real-world impact, we would love to talk.

Join us. Let's build what comes next.

Job Description

Strategic Projects Ownership

Associate will independently own and lead strategic projects that span both core business in data storage as well as New Ventures which covers new business opportunities related to technologies in photonics, magnetics, and nano-fabrication.
Independently lead and own project outputs end-to-end including market sizing, competitive landscaping, end customer and segment analysis, GTM frameworks, build-buy-partner assessments, and more; serve as a credible thought partner to executives and cross-functional stakeholders.
Track timelines, synthesize cross-functional inputs, and deliver against tight deadlines with minimal supervision while escalating appropriately on critical decisions.

Research & Analysis

Conduct primary and secondary research: market sizing, competitive landscaping, customer and partner dynamics, technology trend tracking, and peer benchmarking.

Executive Deliverables

Translate complex analysis into clear, compelling narratives suitable for senior leadership consumption.

Financial & Analytical Modeling

Build and maintain supporting financial and analytical models including market sizing, scenario analysis, business case development, and GTM economics.
Develop quantitative frameworks that underpin strategic recommendations with rigor and defensibility.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to align on strategic priorities, gather inputs, and drive recommendations through to decisions.
Build trusted relationships with commercial, product, and finance stakeholders and drive alignment independently.

Qualifications

Minimum of 3–6 years experience overall with minimum 2 spent in consulting, corporate strategy, investment banking, or a research-intensive analytical role; progressive career trajectory with increasing scope, ownership, and complexity of work over time.
Demonstrated ability to own and lead complex strategic projects end-to-end with C-suite output quality, from problem structuring through to final recommendation.
Strong financial and analytical acumen including models, scenario analysis, and business case development; comfortable with quantitative frameworks.
Experience conducting primary research (expert interviews, customer conversations, channel checks) and secondary research (industry reports, analyst research, public filings) to inform strategic recommendations.
Strong cross-functional collaborator who can build trusted relationships with commercial, product, and finance stakeholders; drives alignment independently.
Experience working with senior leaders and delivering executive-level deliverables independently.
Solid Excel and PowerPoint skills; data visualization a plus.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience supporting or embedded in commercial, GTM, or sales organizations preferred

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience in deep technology, data storage, semiconductor, or enterprise infrastructure.
Experience with competitive intelligence or market research tools (e.g., PitchBook, Bloomberg, Gartner).

Education

MBA or equivalent work experience preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Economics, Finance, or a related analytical field.

Location

San Jose, California (must be willing to relocate)

This is a high-impact analytical role at the center of Western Digital's corporate strategy function, offering direct exposure to the Executive Leadership Team on the company's most important strategic questions. The Associate will independently drive strategic projects championed by senior executives on a wide range of topics and business areas that cover core business (HDD, data storage, infrastructure, AI/cloud) and New Ventures. Do you have a passion for enabling business with secure, top-tier technology? Do you thrive in a fast paced and ever-evolving environment? Then we have the next career move for you! Who are we? We are ARCO, a Family of Construction Companies. The Security Operations Center Manager leads ARCO’s day-to-day security monitoring, detection, and incident response activities. This role manages a team of Cybersecurity Analysts, oversees core security tools, and partners closely with Infrastructure, Applications, and GRC to maintain a strong, resilient security posture. This position is both strategic and hands-on, driving operational excellence, threat mitigation, and continuous improvement. As a senior member of the team, the role requires a strong ability to lead and mentor team members through the strategy directed by senior management. In addition to technical skills, the Services Manager is results-oriented and demonstrates effective problem-solving and communication skills.

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Cybersecurity Analysts responsible for monitoring, triage, and incident response.
Oversee daily SOC operations and ensure timely, effective handling of security alerts and requests.
Automate repetitive tasks and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency.
Maintain and update runbooks, SOPs, escalation workflows, and operational playbooks.
Lead all security incident investigations, containment, and remediation activities.
Conduct regular incident response exercises and postmortems, identifying root causes and tracking improvements.
Stay current on emerging threats and assess ARCO’s readiness to defend against them.
Manage and optimize security tooling (SIEM, IDS/IPS, EDR, SIG, EPM, firewalls, threat intel platforms, etc.).

Participate in change management, project reviews, and technology planning discussions.
Collaborate with Technology teams to identify security gaps and strengthen overall posture.

Necessary Qualifications

7-10 years of cybersecurity operations/engineering experience, including monitoring and incident response.
Experience leading people, developing talent, and managing high-performing teams.
Hands-on experience with core security technologies (SIEM, IDS/IPS, EDR, SIG, EPM, firewalls, vulnerability management, threat intel, SOAR).
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical issues into business risk.

jobs.title: Fulfillment Systems & Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
About Us

Rockstar Original is a fast-growing fashion and e-commerce brand built around bold, trend-driven apparel and a culture of creativity, hustle, and innovation. We move quickly, continuously evolve, and are always looking for better ways to operate as we grow.
Our team is collaborative and hands-on. We value people who take ownership, bring ideas to the table, and aren't afraid to step outside of their job description when something needs to get done.
As our business continues to scale and invest in new warehouse technology, strong systems, data visibility, and fulfillment processes are essential to delivering the experience our customers expect. We're looking for someone who can help us build a smarter, more efficient, and increasingly automated fulfillment operation.

Position Summary

The Fulfillment Systems & Operations Analyst will be responsible for monitoring and improving the systems, workflows, and day-to-day performance behind Rockstar Original's e-commerce fulfillment operation.
This is not a traditional Warehouse Manager position. We're looking for someone who understands how modern e-commerce fulfillment works across WMS, Shopify, ERP/order systems, inventory, shipping, warehouse processes, data, and automation and can connect those pieces to keep orders flowing efficiently.
Working closely with warehouse leadership and cross-functional teams, this person will monitor order volume and fulfillment performance, identify bottlenecks and system issues, troubleshoot problems, and help ensure customer orders are processed accurately and within established SLAs.
This role will also play an important part in the continued evolution of our fulfillment operation, including our WMS environment, systems integrations, process improvements, and future warehouse automation and robotics initiatives.
The ideal candidate is equally comfortable analyzing an order queue or KPI, troubleshooting a WMS workflow, walking the warehouse floor to understand a bottleneck, and working with internal teams or technology partners to implement a better solution.

Key Responsibilities

Monitor daily e-commerce order flow and fulfillment performance, including order volume, aging orders, backlog, throughput, processing times, order accuracy, and on-time shipment rate.
Analyze fulfillment data and operational KPIs to identify bottlenecks, exceptions, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve order throughput and SLA performance.
Become a key operational resource for our Warehouse Management System (WMS), with Infios experience strongly preferred.
Monitor and troubleshoot workflows between the WMS, Shopify, ERP/order systems, shipping platforms, inventory systems, and other fulfillment technologies.
Investigate system, inventory, workflow, picking, packing, shipping, and order-processing issues and drive them toward resolution.
Perform root-cause analysis when orders fall behind or fulfillment performance deviates from established targets.
Work closely with warehouse leadership to develop and execute recovery plans when fulfillment falls behind.
Help maintain accurate and reliable order and inventory data across interconnected systems.
Identify opportunities to improve picking, packing, shipping, replenishment, inventory movement, order prioritization, and overall warehouse workflow.
Build and maintain reporting and visibility around key fulfillment metrics, trends, exceptions, and operational risks.
Proactively identify issues that could impact fulfillment before they develop into larger backlogs or customer-facing problems.
Support the implementation, testing, optimization, and adoption of new WMS functionality, integrations, workflows, and warehouse technology.
Participate in future warehouse automation and robotics initiatives, helping connect new technology with existing WMS processes and operational workflows.
Work cross-functionally with Warehouse, Operations, Customer Service, Inventory, E-Commerce, IT/technology partners, and other teams to resolve fulfillment-related issues.
Document processes, system workflows, standard operating procedures, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
Help evaluate how increasing order volume, SKU count, inventory levels, warehouse capacity, and peak demand affect fulfillment performance and system requirements.

Qualifications

Experience working in e-commerce fulfillment, warehouse systems, supply chain operations, logistics technology, or a similar environment.
Strong hands-on experience with a Warehouse Management System (WMS) required; Infios WMS experience is strongly preferred.
Experience working with Shopify in an e-commerce fulfillment or operations environment strongly preferred.
Familiarity with ERP, OMS (Order Management Systems), inventory management, shipping, and other integrated business systems.
Understanding of how orders and inventory data move between e-commerce platforms, ERP/OMS systems, WMS platforms, and shipping systems.
Experience analyzing operational data including orders per day, units on hand, SKU volume, order backlog, fulfillment throughput, processing time, and shipping SLA performance.
Strong understanding of warehouse fulfillment processes, including receiving, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, inventory movement, and order prioritization.
Experience troubleshooting system and operational issues and performing root-cause analysis.
Familiarity with warehouse automation, robotics, AMRs, conveyors, automated picking/sorting systems, or other material handling technologies is highly desirable.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn operational data into action.
Comfortable learning new technology and working between software systems and physical warehouse operations.
Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with both operational and technical teams.
Highly proactive, organized, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities and order volume can change quickly.
Bilingual Spanish/English required.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who thinks about fulfillment as an interconnected operation of systems, data, people, processes, and technology.

The ideal candidate:

Understands both the physical flow of products and the digital flow of orders and inventory through an e-commerce fulfillment operation.
Can look at order volume, units on hand, backlog, throughput, processing times, and other operational data and quickly understand what is happening.
Knows their way around a WMS and is comfortable investigating why an order, inventory transaction, or workflow isn't behaving as expected.
Understands how platforms such as Shopify, WMS, ERP, OMS, shipping systems, and warehouse technology work together.
Doesn't just report that fulfillment is behind—they investigate why and help drive the solution.
Is excited by warehouse technology, systems integration, automation, and robotics rather than intimidated by them.
Can move comfortably between analyzing data at a computer and walking the warehouse floor to understand what's actually happening.
Thinks in terms of process optimization, scalability, automation, and continuous improvement.
Takes ownership and follows problems through to resolution.
Wants to help build the next generation of Rockstar Original's fulfillment operation rather than simply maintain the status quo.

$120,000–$180,000 annually, dependent on experience and qualifications

Health benefits available

PTO accrual

Opportunity to play a key role in the continued development and modernization of our fulfillment and operations systems

jobs.description:
IMPORTANT: Please be aware, scammers may try to impersonate Zello by reaching out regarding job opportunities. We will never ask you for bank account information, checks, or other sensitive information as part of our hiring process. All correspondence will come from the zello.com email domain. If you’re unsure, please email recruiting@zello.com with questions.

About Zello

Zello is a voice-first communication platform, powered by our industry-leading push-to-talk technology, to improve collaboration and productivity for desk-less workers. With over 175+ million users, we’re the #1 rated push-to-talk app in the world, delivering 9 billion (yes, with a B) messages a month.

At Zello, our company values are at the heart of what we do everyday. We’re proud to serve the frontline, we’re privileged to connect people in times of crisis across the globe, and we’re honored to support first responders.

And this is where you come in.

We're hiring a Product Data Analyst to help us figure out where the product goes next. Zello is push-to-talk for frontline workers - millions of people use it to do their jobs every day - and we want someone who can turn what we see in the data into clear calls about what to build. You'd join the Data & AI team here in Austin.

This one's hands-on and heavily AI-leveraged. You'll dig into the data, form hypotheses, spec the telemetry for our web and mobile apps, run the experiments, and call what ships and what doesn't. You'll lean on AI agents to handle the routine work so your time goes to the thinking that actually moves things.

After a successful first year, you will have

Run 10+ well-powered product experiments end to end, from hypothesis and telemetry spec through analysis to a clear ship-or-kill call, with real impact on activation or conversion.
Defined the events and metrics for a couple of product areas so PMs can pull their own numbers instead of waiting on you.
Shaped the roadmap with your analysis - at least three features that shipped or got killed because of what you found.
Built an AI-leveraged workflow where agents handle the routine pulls, first-pass analysis, and write-ups, so one analyst covers a lot more ground.
Become the person your pod pulls in early, not at the end.

What you'll do

Work with PMs, designers, and engineers to define product metrics, events, and what success looks like.
Design and run A/B tests - scope the hypothesis, make sure it's powered, analyze it honestly, and recommend a call.
Build funnel, retention, and cohort analysis on our mobile and web data with SQL and Python on Snowflake.
Build and run AI-agent workflows that take the grunt work off your plate, and check what they hand back.
Keep the core product dashboards in Omni current so the team isn't waiting on you for the basics.
Turn the analysis into a clear story and a recommendation people can act on.

Who you are

You've owned A/B tests end to end and can point to decisions that changed because of your work, not just dashboards you built.
You write advanced SQL on your own against a cloud warehouse, and you reach for Python when it helps.
You've already reworked how you work around AI - handing routine analysis to agents and checking their output - and you want to push that further.
You pick the right method for the data in front of you instead of running the same test every time.
You don't wait for perfect data. You build the analysis, pressure-test it, and bring a recommendation.
You make work easier for the people around you. PMs and designers find you straightforward to work with.

This role is not

A dashboard or BI-reporting job - dashboards support the work, they're not the work.
A data engineering or pipeline role - the team's got that covered.
A management role - this is a senior IC.
For someone who needs every query and metric handed to them.

We hire for potential, passion for our mission, and a knack for solving difficult problems over checking every qualification box. We have competitive pay, equity with significant upside, and intentionally design our benefits to encourage healthy and well-balanced employees, flexible schedules and time off. We even offer a sabbatical after every five years of service so you’re able to pursue and enjoy what matters most to you. And of course, we wouldn’t be a technology company without a ping-pong table and free snacks in our break room. Join us!

new_jobs.title: Sr Technical Program Manager, AWS Supply Chain Enablement & Risk Management
new_jobs.description:
Description

In this role, you will be part of the team that ensures AWS's supply chain can deliver the datacenter racks, servers, and networking equipment to our datacenters across the globe. The rest of the supply chain looks to us to clear strategic problems and "enable" them to focus on execution. We are the jack-of-all-trades with the best understanding of how the entire end-to-end supply chain works and how to help it run better.

This is a high-judgment role, where you will represent the AWS supply chain during engagements with public sector customers, and must be able to translate customer and regulatory requirements into actionable deliverables, determine what is a true requirement versus a nice-to-have, and understand how to find the balance between cybersecurity and business objectives.

The ideal candidate is a technically savvy individual leader, capable of leveraging AWS's internal business and artificial intelligence tool to gather data and identify risks before they become problems, as well as interact with both internal and external senior leaders to gain support for new initiatives and obtain consensus with AWS customers.

You will be responsible for identifying, creating, and delivering on your initiatives and must have both excellent interpersonal and writing skills to work across myriad teams in the supply chain, security, and legal organizations to deliver results in an ambiguous operating environment. It will be your responsibility to ensure the supply chain delivers on our security and risk management commitments to our customers, as well as make sure region build and operational teams are able to get the infrastructure hardware they need when they need it.

This position requires that the selected candidate already be a UK citizen and, after starting, obtain the commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities

Driving consensus and standardization for acceptable levels of risk and best practices across supply chain operations
Developing technical solutions that drive automation at scale to ensure datacenter infrastructure is delivered on-time, in-full
Proactively working with other organizations to anticipate gaps between teams, processes, and system architectures, influencing where no formal reporting structures exist
Articulating in writing (actual papers, not slides) key issues and strategic initiatives for senior leadership
Acting as a thought and business leader in the field of cybersecurity, supply chain risk management, and supply chain operations

A day in the life

You are at the intersection of the Venn diagram for security, operations, and risk management, and thus work with a variety of different stakeholders. You will primarily focus on addressing supply chain security and risk concerns for UK-based public sector customers to allow the supply chain to operate smoothly, but the team supports our global footprint and you will collaborate with international peers to drive standardization and scalable practices across the global supply chain.

About The Team

Our team has the greatest end-to-end view and understanding of AWS's supply chain and sits at the center of the Venn diagram of supply chain security, operations, and risk management. We build bridges with both internal and external customers across those different disciplines to find the right balance between them.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Experience working with large, complex data sets

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with AWS data warehouse and reporting technologies like Redshift, Athena, S3, etc.
Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages

new_jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Workplace Health & Safety, AMZL NA
new_jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company, to be the best employer, and to be the safest place to work on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented and driven people. If you'd like to help us build that place, this is your chance to make history.

One focus area of the North America Amazon Logistics (AMZL) network is to provide tools, resources, and environments that support safe, efficient, and healthy behaviors and encourage employees to proactively manage their health and wellbeing. To support this focus area, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative person to serve as a Program Manager for AMZL WHS to build and execute programs that create a safe workplace and build a world-class safety culture in the midst of Amazon’s growth. In this role, you will dive deep into Operations processes; identify risks through data and first-hand experience; build and execute programs, and improve processes to eliminate risks; and influence Operations to sustain a culture of safety. This role will focus on coordinating and leading large, strategic projects within AMZL and will be strongly focused on injury and accident prevention as well as improvements across health, safety and wellness.

The WHS Program Manager role will challenge you to push boundaries and lead transformative innovation while having the autonomy to make rapid data-driven decisions and invent on behalf of Operators (operation leaders) and Team Members. In this role, you will work cross-functionally with members from various teams, including Operations; Human Resources, Procurement, Finance, WHS, Reliability, Engineering and Maintenance, Finance and OpEx to deploy solutions at scale. This role calls for an individual who is technically smart to gain credibility with customers and stakeholders at various levels of the organization.

The role will report into the Senior Manager, Strategic Initiatives for AMZL WHS and work collaboratively with other partners across all Amazon BUs and regional geographies to provide innovative solutions across our business. This role is based out of the Seattle, WA, Arlington, VA, or Nashville, TN corporate locations and will require 25% travel to support project deployments, factory acceptance tests (FATs), strategy meetings, and for process improvement Kaizen events.

The ideal candidate has an obsession for customers and a strong interest in building innovative solutions; must have proven analytical capabilities (including ability to deep dive, identify root causes and permanently eliminate hazards and risks); and can thrive in a fast-paced environment with exceptional communication and project management skills. The ideal candidate must have sound judgment, compassion, and interpersonal skills with the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues in many areas across the company.

Key job responsibilities

Develop, review, approve, coordinate, and lead large, strategic projects / programs within Amazon Business Units (BUs) and across different geographies.

Build relationships and partner across many organizations to build and execute on new initiatives and roadmaps each year.

Work and collaborate with stakeholders and partners to align on project /program goals and resources.

Coordinate a portfolio of programs / projects from inception to delivery.

Define and implement metrics to measure and communicate program achievements.

Compile, manage and report on weekly project metrics and be responsible for leading many high profile meetings to align on project requirements.

Communicate the overall program roadmap and provide periodic status updates to the stakeholders, and presenting programs / projects to senior leadership on a regular basis.

Provide programs decision support, insights and recommendations through data gathering and information analyzing.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree, or Master's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
2+ years of driving process improvements experience

Responsibilities

The Project Manager will lead and manage complex engineering projects across substation design, transmission, telecommunications, renewable energy interconnections, electric utilities and large load industrial facilities.
Work with project teams including engineers, designers, and subcontractors in the coordination of project documents and drawings, ensuring schedules are met.
Manage project scope, budget, scheduling, and change control throughout the project lifecycle.
Support procurement and construction activities, including managing site construction managers and procurement teams.
Establish and maintain professional relationships with our external business partners.
Support proposal development including scope definition, cost estimating, schedule creation, and vendor quote evaluation.
Coordinate overall conceptual design plans in the initial development phase of large load, renewable energy and battery storage projects specific to utility interconnections and/or non-grid connections.
Coordinate environmental permitting and land rights as needed with clients, agencies and staff.
Assist clients with competitive bidding processes for steel structures, long lead electrical equipment and substation construction activities.
Mentor less experienced staff on a wide range of technical and project management best practices and competencies.
Participate in internal process improvements and help to develop Qualus's project control systems and standards.
Work with large load developers, renewable energy developers and other clients with support specific to schedules and cost estimates.
Prepare and maintain project schedules as needed and coordinate with team members and clients on schedule impacts.
Track budgets, prepare regular project status reports, and conduct team/client meetings.
Generally, keep management appraised of project status and report as needed to clients, agencies, and team members. This often includes facilitating monthly or bi-weekly team meetings and issuing meeting notes
Occasional travel (1–2 times per month) with overnight stays required.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience managing or supporting utility, power delivery, electrical infrastructure, commercial, industrial, renewable energy, or related engineering projects.
Experience managing project budgets, forecasts, schedules, resource planning, and contract deliverables.
Knowledge of utility industry standards, regulations, and environmental/permitting requirements.
Working knowledge of electrical power systems and utility project execution, including transmission, substation, generation, renewable energy, industrial facilities, or similar infrastructure projects.
Demonstrated understanding of project management principles, including scope, schedule, budget, risk, and stakeholder management.
Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
Customer-focused mindset with the ability to build and maintain effective client relationships.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. Description

The Alexa Connections organization is seeking a season and highly strategic Sr. Program Manager to serve as Chief of Staff focused on operations, go-to-market (GTM), and strategic partnerships. In this role, you will lead and execute large-scale complex projects and programs that have a significant impact on Alexa Connections’ business goals and customer experience. You will help translate the organization’s product vision into actionable operating plans, differentiated customer experiences, compelling launch strategies, and scalable third-party partnerships. With a wealth of experience and a deep understanding of program management principles, you will excel in driving innovation, influencing senior stakeholders, and shaping the strategic direction of the organization while ensuring Connections is positioned as an integral part of the broader Alexa+ experience.

Key job responsibilities

Organize and communicate program and mechanism deadlines, coordinate program-level initiatives across senior managers, collaborate laterally with adjacent organizations, track and report on key metrics and progress, run business mechanisms, lead planning for business events, and manage headcount, workforce planning, and recruiting initiatives.

Serve as a strategic and operational partner to Alexa Connections leadership, establishing mechanisms that translate organizational priorities into clear plans, accountable owners, measurable goals, and timely decisions.

Drive cross-functional GTM programs that align Alexa Connections’ positioning, product value proposition, and launch plans with the broader Alexa+ strategy and customer experience.

Create mechanisms that surface and scale bottom-up innovation across the Connections organization, translating emerging ideas and customer insights into prioritized, customer-obsessed product experiences.

Develop crisp, high-quality marketing and communication materials for product launches and other key business moments, including positioning, messaging, launch narratives, FAQs, executive briefings, and partner-facing collateral.

Define and drive product and partnership strategies that enable the efficient onboarding and scaling of third-party partners. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Business Development, Marketing, Legal, and other cross-functional teams to clarify requirements, remove onboarding friction, and establish shared success measures.

Build and maintain productive relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners, ensuring that partnership opportunities support the organization’s product roadmap, customer experience, and long-term growth objectives.

A day in the life

The day in the life of a program manager on the Alexa Connections team is full of coordination, communication, and driving deadlines. You will manage multiple streams of communication across internal and external teams and with senior leaders. You will drive key planning and coordination activities between managers and individual contributors. As Chief of Staff, you will move fluidly between strategic planning, operating reviews, product and launch working sessions, partner discussions, executive communications, and program execution. On any given day, you may align teams around a GTM decision, develop materials for a product launch, evaluate a third-party partnership opportunity, surface a bottom-up innovation proposal, or establish the mechanisms needed to move a complex initiative forward.

5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

Experience developing product positioning, messaging, launch strategies, or customer- and partner-facing marketing materials

Experience designing and scaling cross-functional programs in large or complex organizations, including using data and analytics to guide program and investment decisions
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into crisp recommendations and decision-ready materials

We are seeking up to two (2) Cybersecurity Analysts with experience implementing artificial intelligence (AI) for computer network defense including intrusion detection, prevention and incident response activities. Implement AI-enabled solutions for cybersecurity operations and adapt existing processes to integrate emerging AI capabilities into standard operations.
Provide key requirements, observations, design suggestions, and artifacts to inform the development of AI technologies that will support the adoption of AI technology into cybersecurity operations.
Monitor real-time network activity flagged by a variety of intrusion detection, prevention, and analysis platforms and analyze raw data, metadata, and event logs to confirm suspected intrusion attempts into either local (on-premises) or cloud computing systems and use that information to inform the creation of AI-enabled cyber defense capabilities.

new_jobs.title: Business analyst
new_jobs.description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
Understand.
Build a 360° understanding of your product, users, business model, competitive landscape, and economics. Use AI, data, and research to uncover key business drivers, diagnose challenges, and identify opportunities for growth and product development.
Ideate.
Turn insights into concrete opportunities and hypotheses for testing. Explore new products features, growth initiatives, monetization opportunities, and improvements to how the business operates, prioritizing those with the greatest potential impact.
Execute.
Turn the most promising opportunities into action and clear customer value. Support roadmap conversations with enterprise clients, build the business case, and work cross-functionally with engineering, design, and other teams to bring initiatives to life.
Optimize.
Use A/B tests, business and product metrics, and ongoing analysis to understand what works and what doesn’t. Scale successful initiatives, improve existing ones, and use each result to inform the next cycle of discovery and execution.

What we look for
Reasoning ability.
Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Drive.
You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Team spirit.
You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English.
You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offer
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams.
You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
An exceptional opportunity for growth.
We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
All. These. Benefits.
Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount.
Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.

Commitment & contract

Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location

Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process

In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply

If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

new_jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company, to be the best employer, and to be the safest place to work on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented and driven people. If you'd like to help us build that place, this is your chance to make history.

One focus area of the North America Amazon Logistics (AMZL) network is to provide tools, resources, and environments that support safe, efficient, and healthy behaviors and encourage employees to proactively manage their health and wellbeing. To support this focus area, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative person to serve as a Program Manager for AMZL WHS to build and execute programs that create a safe workplace and build a world-class safety culture in the midst of Amazon’s growth. In this role, you will dive deep into Operations processes; identify risks through data and first-hand experience; build and execute programs, and improve processes to eliminate risks; and influence Operations to sustain a culture of safety. This role will focus on coordinating and leading large, strategic projects within AMZL and will be strongly focused on injury and accident prevention as well as improvements across health, safety and wellness.

The WHS Program Manager role will challenge you to push boundaries and lead transformative innovation while having the autonomy to make rapid data-driven decisions and invent on behalf of Operators (operation leaders) and Team Members. In this role, you will work cross-functionally with members from various teams, including Operations; Human Resources, Procurement, Finance, WHS, Reliability, Engineering and Maintenance, Finance and OpEx to deploy solutions at scale. This role calls for an individual who is technically smart to gain credibility with customers and stakeholders at various levels of the organization.

The role will report into the Senior Manager, Strategic Initiatives for AMZL WHS and work collaboratively with other partners across all Amazon BUs and regional geographies to provide innovative solutions across our business. This role is based out of the Seattle, WA, Arlington, VA, or Nashville, TN corporate locations and will require 25% travel to support project deployments, factory acceptance tests (FATs), strategy meetings, and for process improvement Kaizen events.

The ideal candidate has an obsession for customers and a strong interest in building innovative solutions; must have proven analytical capabilities (including ability to deep dive, identify root causes and permanently eliminate hazards and risks); and can thrive in a fast-paced environment with exceptional communication and project management skills. The ideal candidate must have sound judgment, compassion, and interpersonal skills with the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues in many areas across the company.

Key job responsibilities

Develop, review, approve, coordinate, and lead large, strategic projects / programs within Amazon Business Units (BUs) and across different geographies.

Build relationships and partner across many organizations to build and execute on new initiatives and roadmaps each year.

Work and collaborate with stakeholders and partners to align on project /program goals and resources.

Coordinate a portfolio of programs / projects from inception to delivery.

Define and implement metrics to measure and communicate program achievements.

Compile, manage and report on weekly project metrics and be responsible for leading many high profile meetings to align on project requirements.

Communicate the overall program roadmap and provide periodic status updates to the stakeholders, and presenting programs / projects to senior leadership on a regular basis.

Provide programs decision support, insights and recommendations through data gathering and information analyzing.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree, or Master's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
2+ years of driving process improvements experience

new_jobs.description:
THE ROLE

As our Asset Operations Analyst
, you'll ensure regulatory, contractual, and commercial compliance across a dedicated portfolio — working closely with technical, finance, and ESG teams to keep assets compliant, profitable, and aligned with our standards.

This role plays a key part in protecting asset value and supporting WiseEnergy
's mission of enabling the global transition to clean energy.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the management of commercial contracts (PPAs, SPAs, leases, EPC and O&M contracts, market representation agreements)
Oversee the full contract lifecycle, from onboarding new sites to integrating key terms into our systems
Ensure compliance with environmental regulations and licensing requirements
Prepare revenue budgets, forecasts, and support asset operating plans
Manage insurance renewals, claims, and landowner relationships
Support ESG compliance and reporting activities
Collaborate cross-functionally with technical and finance teams
Drive continuous improvement of contract management processes and tools

Skills & Competencies

To be successful in this role, you will demonstrate:

Excellent communication and presentation skills (in English and Italian) - you must be able to organize your thoughts in a way that others find clear and compelling. You will be expected to put together well-written, grammatically correct emails, presentations and other communications. When communicating verbally – whether over the phone, on video calls, in person or in meetings – you will need to be articulate and engaging.
Time management & prioritization skills - the ability to effectively manage yourself and your workload is critical.
Fast Learner – Our US portfolio spans multiple states (New York, Virginia and North Carolina) with differing PPAs and regulatory requirements in each. Being able to quickly digest, learn and adapt to these differing challenges is key
Flexibility - being an effective team player means being flexible in your approach and open to getting involved with new things, even if they are not spelt out in your job description.
Delivery focus – it may sound obvious, but the ability to proactively churn through work at pace and deliver quality outputs really matters.
IT literacy - you need to be comfortable with IT systems and working with data, particularly Excel.
Passion for our mission ‘to generate a more sustainable future by leading the transition to clean energy.
Our values: be a leader, build trust, be responsible, be innovative and ‘bring your alpha’.

Experience & Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Law, Economics, Engineering, or related field
2–3 years' experience in a similar role, ideally within renewable energy
Strong background in regulatory, property, and contract management
Fluent English and Italian (mandatory); Spanish or Portuguese is a plus
Advanced Microsoft Office skills (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)

A busy role in a supportive team, with plenty of opportunities to learn

new_jobs.description:
Description

The IDC Analytics team is looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Business Analyst I to join our team and contribute to the analytics foundation that powers AWS Marketing’s demand generation engine. In this entry-level role, you will execute analyses, build dashboards, and support the data pipelines that underpin campaign performance reporting across the IDC organization. You will work closely with senior analysts and marketing stakeholders to deliver accurate, timely reporting while developing your analytical skills in a fast-paced, data-rich environment. This is an ideal opportunity for someone early in their career who is passionate about turning raw data into actionable insights, enjoys hands-on SQL and dashboard work, and wants to grow their craft within one of the most analytically driven marketing teams at AWS.

Key job responsibilities

Execute analytical requests from marketing stakeholders, delivering accurate data pulls, ad-hoc analyses, and structured summaries
Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reports in QuickSight to support campaign performance tracking and operational visibility
Write SQL queries against Redshift to extract and transform marketing data for reporting and analysis
Perform data quality checks and validation to ensure accuracy and consistency across reporting pipelines
Support senior analysts in developing measurement frameworks, attribution analyses, and funnel reporting
Collaborate with data engineering to troubleshoot ETL pipeline issues and improve data reliability
Use AI tools (such as Kiro IDE, Amazon Quick, and MCP-based assistants) to accelerate data exploration, query generation, and reporting workflows
Support the development of AI-powered automations for data validation and report generation, reducing manual turnaround times
Assist in gathering and documenting business requirements from marketing stakeholders, translating them into Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) used by D:SE (Data Science & Engineering) and S&O (Strategy & Operations) teams to build and enhance performance dashboards
Document analytical methodologies, query logic, and reporting processes in team knowledge bases
Prepare data summaries and visualizations for weekly and monthly business reviews

A day in the life

Your focus is turning marketing data into clear answers. Most mornings, you’ll check dashboards to see how campaigns perform, dig into anomalies, and share findings with the marketers running those campaigns before they even ask. You’ll write SQL against large datasets to deep dive and do root cause analysis - connecting top of funnel metrics to revenue impact. You’ll partner with teams to translate their questions into structured analytical plans, and use AI tools to automate reporting, validate data, and speed up your workflows. When something interesting surfaces, you won’t wait to be asked - you’ll bring it to the table.

About The Team

The Integrated Demand Center (IDC) is AWS Marketing’s unified function for planning, delivering, and measuring demand generation at scale. The IDC Analytics team sits within Demand Services, the shared services arm powering campaign execution and innovation. We generate actionable insights across the IDC — delivering analytics, custom reporting, and clear recommendations that help teams optimize performance, strengthen adoption, and accelerate revenue impact. Our work spans configuring dashboards, defining and monitoring delivery KPIs, translating business requirements into technical specifications, supporting steering reviews and QBRs, and partnering with marketers to transform complex data into data-driven decisions at strategic, tactical, and operational levels.

Bachelor's degree in mathematics, engineering, statistics, computer science or a related field
2+ years of Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables) experience
Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
Experience with SQL or ETL

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages
Experience using very large datasets
Experience in Online Advertising/Marketing/Sales/Digital Media

new_jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Alexa Connected Devices
new_jobs.description:
Description

Alexa+ is Amazon's next-generation AI-powered personal assistant, built on large language models to deliver natural, conversational, and context-aware experiences for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. We are building new services and experiences for Alexa+ customers from the ground up, and we're looking for an experienced, generative AI-savvy Senior Technical Program Manager to help drive them to delivery.

In this role, you will lead complex, cross-functional programs that span multiple engineering teams building Tier-1 cloud services and real-time experiences for hundreds of millions of devices and customers. You'll turn ambiguous, large-scale technical challenges into clear roadmaps, drive execution across organizational boundaries, and ensure we deliver experiences that redefine what a personal assistant can do. You'll operate at the intersection of engineering and product — bringing structure to greenfield initiatives and keeping fast-moving teams aligned, unblocked, and shipping.

Why You'll Love It Here

Large-scale, high-visibility programs: You'll plan, lead, and orchestrate technically rich initiatives at a scale few programs encounter — coordinating across many teams to deliver solutions for our customers. And we don't just build AI products; we use generative AI extensively in our own planning and execution, keeping you at the forefront of the field.
High-impact, collaborative partners: Join a team of passionate engineers and product managers who support each other, share knowledge freely, and celebrate wins together — and who value the clarity and momentum a great TPM brings.
Greenfield opportunity: We're building from the ground up, giving you the chance to shape not just architecture and program, but the very mechanisms, processes, and delivery culture from day one.
World-changing impact: The programs you drive will directly shape how hundreds of millions of customers interact with their personal assistant every day.

Key job responsibilities

Own and drive end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-organizational technical programs — from ambiguous concept through launch and operation — including requirements, technical design, planning, risk mitigation, and stakeholder communication.
Contribute to annual and quarterly planning cycles, translating organizational strategy into actionable program plans.
Partner cross-functionally with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to align priorities, make trade-off decisions, and communicate program status to senior leadership.
Establish and improve mechanisms — status reporting, operational reviews, launch readiness, and audit metrics — that create visibility and explain variance against goals.
Drive engineering and operational excellence by embedding quality, reliability, and launch-readiness standards into program planning and execution.
Champion the use of generative AI both in the experiences we ship and in our own program and engineering practices to accelerate time to market.

About The Team

The Alexa Connected Devices team designs, builds, and operates the core horizontal services that power Alexa — the world's largest IoT installation and most capable, efficient, and trusted AI assistant. We deliver the capabilities that let Alexa connect, discover, set up, and manage over 1 billion connected endpoints across Echo, Fire TV, Smart Home, Mobile, and Apps.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
5+ years of technical product or program management experience
3+ years of software development experience
5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

new_jobs.title: Sr. Worldwide Program Manager, Data & AI GTM
new_jobs.description:
Description

This isn't your typical program management role. You'll be the person who ensures the infrastructure behind AWS's Data & AI sales plays actually works, and works well. That means holding a high bar on sales play templates, bill of materials quality, reporting, and content management so that everything the AWS sales field touches is accurate, up-to-date, and ready to drive impact. You'll own and continuously improve the knowledge base of sales plays, reusable content, and industry use cases that enables our sellers, and the agentic experiences that assist them, to help customers faster and more effectively. Think of this role as running the center of excellence for Data & AI sales plays: setting the standard, maintaining the system, and making sure what we put in front of AWS field teams and assistance agents is always sharp and current.

You'll drive global GTM initiatives from the ground up, identifying where the biggest opportunities are, packaging them into repeatable motions, and making sure they land with impact across regions and industries. If a sales team in financial services needs a sharper AI use case to unlock a deal, or if healthcare needs a data play that resonates with CIOs, that's your infrastructure and content showing up in the field.

What makes this role different is the scope and the leverage. You're not supporting one team or one product. You're shaping how AWS's entire Data & AI story gets organized, maintained, and delivered across the globe. You'll work across product, business development, solutions architecture, marketing, sales, and partner teams to make that happen, and you'll see your impact in real numbers: pipeline created, deals accelerated, revenue driven.

If you like building systems that scale, thrive in ambiguity, and want to work at the intersection of program rigor and GTM execution in one of the fastest-moving spaces in tech, this is the job.

Key job responsibilities

Serve as the center of excellence for Data & AI sales plays, setting and enforcing standards for sales play templates, completion, bills of materials, use case documentation, content management, and quality across the portfolio
Own and continuously improve the knowledge base of sales plays, reusable content, and industry use cases that enables our sales field and assistance agents to help customers more effectively
Influence cross-functional teams to design, build, and scale repeatable sales plays while driving a high bar for bills of materials that directly address friction points in the customer sales cycle, delivered through both traditional methods and agentic experiences
Manage sales play and use case reporting, tracking performance metrics like pipeline generated, sales acceleration, and win/revenue realization rates, and continuously iterating based on what the data and anecdotes tell you
Help develop industry-focused use cases (e.g., financial services, healthcare, manufacturing) that show customers exactly how AWS Data & AI solves their specific challenges
Partner cross-functionally with product, solutions architecture, marketing, sales, and partner teams to ensure GTM initiatives are aligned, resourced, and landing with impact across regions
Ensure the infrastructure of sales acceleration content is accurate, current, and structured to power both human sellers and agentic experiences at scale
Drive executive-level alignment on GTM priorities, making the case for where to invest and ensuring stakeholders across the business are rowing in the same direction

A day in the life

Your morning might start with a call reviewing pipeline data to see which sales plays are gaining traction and which need retooling. By mid-morning, you're in a working session with product and marketing teams, pressure-testing a new set of industry use case for financial services before it goes live to the field. After lunch, you're collaborating with a specialist sales leader in Australia who's seeing friction in a deal cycle and needs a sharper bill of materials — and you're figuring out how to deliver it both through traditional enablement channels and agentic experiences. Late afternoon, you're pulling together an executive memo that makes the case for doubling down on a GTM motion that's outperforming expectations. No two days look the same, but the throughline is always the same: connecting strategy to execution and making sure what you build actually moves numbers.

About The Team

We're a worldwide team that sits at the crossroads of AWS's Data & AI portfolio, working across categories rather than within a single product lane. Our job is to take everything AWS offers in the Data & AI space and package it into GTM sales motions that are clear, compelling, and easy for the AWS field to execute. That means driving campaigns, sales plays, field activations, and sales incentives, and doing it in close partnership with marketing, product, business development, and solutions architecture teams. We connect a lot of dots so that when a sales play lands in the hands of field teams anywhere in the world, it's sharp, complete, and ready to drive pipeline. If you like working horizontally across big organizations and turning complexity into simplicity, you'll feel right at home here.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

This position is located in the Department of General Services (DGS). The mission of DGS is to manage the capital improvement and construction program for District government facilities; acquire (by purchase or lease) real property for use by the District government, managing space in buildings and adjacent areas operated and leased by the District government; provide building services for facilities owned and occupied by the District government, including engineering services, custodial services, security services, energy conservation, utilities management, maintenance, inspection and planning and repairs and non-structural improvements; and, dispose of District real and personal property through sales, leases, or other authorized methods.

The Program Analyst specializes in HVAC and Facility Operations serves as a principal analyst overseeing the performance, cost-efficiency, and regulatory compliance of HVAC and climate-control assets across the organization’s building portfolio. The scope is evaluative and analytical, involving the analysis of operational data, evaluation of the effectiveness of preventive maintenance frameworks initiatives, and ensuring the compliance with municipal clean air and energy mandates. The analyst translates mechanical, energy, and air-quality data into actionable maintenance policies, contract guidelines, and capital project justifications for senior executive leadership. Independently designs and executes studies to evaluate the productivity and cost-effectiveness of the department's HVAC operations (such as comparing reactive repairs against preventive maintenance schedules). The analyst also monitors utility trends, lifecycle costs, and replacement rates of boilers, chillers, and air handling units (AHUs), conducts comprehensive cost-benefit analyses for facility-wide equipment replacements.

Duties And Responsibilities

Provides critical analyses and evaluations of actual or potential effectiveness of current and/or projected program activities. Provides technical assistance in the design, development and implementation of improved program designs/operations. Reviews and analyzes planning and operations activities of major program areas administered by the department.

Conducts management surveys, audits, projects, etc., and provides advisory services to operating or management officials. Recommends the establishment of new and/or revised policies, procedures and other documentation, as the need arises, to more effectively meet the goals and objectives. Makes recommendations to get the program and operation in compliance. Reviews legislation and ensure that program(s) are in compliance. Conducts continuous review and analysis of current or proposed programs and related administrative and financial activities; determines, through comprehensive assessment, effective utilization of resources at program level; identifies program strengths and deficiencies; and recommends changes or corrective action relative to program design, policies, procedures, and operations.

Qualifications And Education

Specialized Experience: Specialized experience is experience which is directly related to the position and has equipped the individual with the knowledge, skills, and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position. To be creditable, at least one (1) year of specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the next lower grade level in the normal line of progression.
