About the role:

As we evolve our security posture to meet growth and regulatory expectations, we are seeking a transformational Senior Information Security Manager to lead our technical security team and operationalize security capabilities that are measurable, effective, and aligned with business priorities. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will lead the day-to-day execution of the security program and directly manage the security engineering and analyst team, while partnering closely with the U.S.-based VP of Information Security and the compliance and privacy operations team.

Location: Czech Republic (Remote). Working hours for this role are aligned to U.S. Central Time (Austin) core business hours to ensure real-time collaboration with the U.S.-based security leadership and compliance team.

This role is hired through an Employer of Record (EOR) partner in the Czech Republic.

About us:

8am builds software that helps professionals run stronger businesses. Our platform powers payments, client experience, and operational workflows for legal, accounting, and other service-based businesses. U.S. based professionals count on our purpose-built solutions to simplify operations, ensure compliance, and fuel profitable growth, so they can focus on their clients and do more of the work that matters.

More than 250,000 professionals across the U.S. rely on our products every day. As we continue to grow, we're investing in the next generation of our platform and are looking for experienced engineers who want to help shape its future.

What you'll do:

Team leadership
: Lead and develop the security engineering/analyst team — delivery, prioritization, coaching, performance
Security operations
: Own security platforms (EDR, SIEM, compliance automation, vulnerability management, CSPM) and detection/response workflows
Metrics & reporting
: Own security metrics pipeline (remediation velocity, control assurance, coverage) for quarterly business reviews
AI security
: Drive AI adoption in tooling for better detection, and define/enforce security standards for AI/agentic systems (LLM integrations, orchestration, governance)
Incident & compliance leadership
: Lead incident response (EU hours, US coordination), post-incident reviews, and partner on compliance audits (SOC 2, PCI DSS, EU regs)
Security design reviews
: Lead design reviews across product lines with risk ratings, SLAs, and documented standards
Threat intel & detection engineering
: Monitor relevant threat intel and convert into actionable detections
Fraud/attack investigation
: Partner cross-functionally to investigate attacks (card testing, fraud, abuse), turning findings into detections and hardening recommendations

About you:

7+ years in information security, including 2+ years leading technical security staff.
Hands-on depth in cloud security operations (AWS preferred), SIEM/log analytics, EDR platforms, and vulnerability management programs.
Track record of building measurable, metrics-driven security programs in a compliance-heavy environment (PCI DSS, SOC 2, or equivalent).
Experience operating in distributed, cross-timezone teams; excellent written communication.
Fluent professional English.
Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools and technologies to improve workflows, enhance decision-making, or drive innovation.
This position is preferably based in Brno, Czech Republic

Bonus points:

Experience securing or governing AI/LLM systems and agentic tooling.
Familiarity with EU regulatory landscape (GDPR) and fintech or legal-tech domains.

Additional Information

The monthly gross salary range for this position is CZK 95,000 to CZK 175,000. 8am is committed to fair, objective, and non-discriminatory compensation, and actual pay may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and education.

Why join our new 8am Brno hub?

Founding Team Impact:
Be a founding engineer of our new Brno R&D hub. After a brief 1-6 month integration with U.S. based teams, you will help form fully autonomous, locally-led squads with clear paths to Staff and leadership roles
Drive our "AI-First" Transformation:
We are building a secure, massive-scale "Unified AI Platform". Depending on your squad, you will either help architect this core infrastructure (LLM routing, RAG, agent orchestration) or build directly on top of it.
Build the Next Generation of Our Platform:
Help shape the systems powering products used by more than 250,000 professionals. You'll work on complex platform capabilities across payments, workflow automation, and AI-powered features as we expand into new professional service markets.

About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About The Role

Business Operations is Rippling’s strike team for high-stakes, mission-critical challenges. We are the architects behind product development, go-to-market strategies, and scale operations across the entire company. Operating as the connective tissue for our compound startup, this small, elite unit brings structure to massive ambiguity and executes with relentless precision.

We need BizOps Managers who are world-class problem solvers, first-principles thinkers, and fearless operators. You won't just advise, you will build from 0-to-1, tackle the company’s biggest strategic bets, and partner directly with executive leadership. For high-performers, this role is the ultimate launchpad into executive leadership at an ultra-high-growth company.

What You'll Do

Hunt Down High-Impact Problems: Identify critical business friction points, step into the fire, and build scalable solutions alongside senior leaders.
Master the Revenue Engine: Architect and refine monetization, pricing, and packaging strategies to aggressively accelerate market dominance.
Drive Cross-Functional Force-Multiplier Projects: Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and GTM teams to launch new initiatives and revolutionize operational systems.
Own Your Data: Dig into raw databases, build custom SQL queries, construct dashboards, and extract actionable insight without needing a safety net.
Set the Source of Truth: Collaborate with Finance and RevOps to define, standardize, and scale the operational metrics that steer the entire business.

What You'll Need

4+ years of battle-tested experience in top-tier management consulting, BizOps, VC/PE, or as a startup founder. Exceptional talent with fewer years but a proven track record of rapid acceleration will be considered.
Cross-functional mastery: A deep understanding of organizational dynamics in high-velocity tech environments.
A data-first instinct: You instinctively open a spreadsheet, code a query, or analyze a dataset before building a slide deck.
Extreme altitude-switching: Equally comfortable pitching strategy to C-suite executives as you are getting into the weeds with frontline operators.
Relentless ownership and grit: You don't pass the mic or make excuses—you take full accountability and solve problems permanently.
High-conviction autonomy: You thrive in chaos, make sound calls with incomplete data, and move fast without waiting for a playbook.

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. new_jobs.title: Senior Staff Deployment Strategist, Operations
new_jobs.description:
About ALSO.

We’re ALSO, an electric mobility company originally conceived as a part of Rivian. We’re a passionate team of builders, dreamers, doers and innovators, focused on creating entirely new (not to mention, innovative and delightful) vertically integrated, small EVs designed to meet the global mobility challenges of today and tomorrow. Our mission is to inspire everyone to ride ALSO—replacing many local car, truck and SUV miles with ones on vehicles that are more affordable, more enjoyable and 10-50x more efficient.

ALSO is becoming a manufacturer, with serialized vehicles moving from production lines to customers. The systems to manage that transition largely don’t exist yet.

You’ll build ALSO’s operating system for making and moving vehicles—from CM production to the customer’s door—creating a single source of truth for planning, quality, inventory, delivery, and decision-making. Today, much of this runs on spreadsheets and tribal knowledge; you’ll turn it into scalable systems and close the loop so decisions happen within them.

As the Senior Staff Deployment Strategist, Operations,
you’ll help take ALSO from startup to a mature, class-leading operator. You’ll report to our Director of Enterprise Data and work closely with supply chain, manufacturing, quality, finance, and commercial teams. There are no direct reports today; you’ll lead through architecture, code, and influence.

What You Will Do

Build end-to-end visibility from factory to customer: WIP, first-pass yield, as-built genealogy from module to vehicle, inventory down to supplier-held stock, and shipment status.
Build the planning engine across both supply chains, what we buy from our CMs and what we assemble ourselves: material planning at SKU-by-day, available-to-promise, and the build and fulfillment queues.
Run the supplier loop: PO confirmations, promise dates, RFQs, design changes, the forecast we release to tiers 1 through 3, and component pricing with effectivity.
Run the physical moves: booking, importation and track-and-trace from CM to 3PL to customer, plus the visibility feed out of our CMs’ own systems.
Close the quality loop: incoming and inline quality, deviations and trends, warranty tracing, and a defect traced to a supplier chargeback that lands in the financial system.
Settle buy-versus-build by shipping: stand up a thin, disposable app for quality, transport and warehouse visibility, run the process instrumented, and let evidence pick the platform we buy later.
Engineer the process before you automate it: instrument how the work actually runs, including the exceptions nobody wrote down, delete the steps that exist only because two systems could not talk, then automate what survives. Paving the cowpath faster is not the job.
Ship with coding agents in days rather than quarters.
Embed with the team that owns a process, automate it with them, and leave them able to change it themselves. Success is the owner shipping their own improvements, not filing tickets for you.

What You Will Bring

8+ years building operations, manufacturing or supply chain software from zero to production, owning the data model and decision logic. Technical degree or equivalent hands-on experience.
Daily LLM-native development with coding agents such as Claude, and a real method for proving model output correct: contracts, tests, evals and review.
A track record of rapid iteration: working software in users’ hands in days, then improved from how it actually gets used.
Deep SaaS platform expertise: integrating QMS, TMS, WMS or ERP into one data platform, and the judgment to know when a package earns its place and when it is the slow path.
Python, SQL and API fluency, plus enough physical-operations sense to turn conflicting data into one honest picture.
Comfort earning an unfamiliar team's trust, and moving to the next constraint once the automation is live.
Willingness to travel internationally to our contract manufacturers in Taiwan when the work calls for it.

This role includes regular on-site presence in Palo Alto, time on the warehouse floor, and occasional international travel. The salary for this position ranges from $170,000 to $225,000 per year,
depending on experience and qualifications.

Perks And Benefits

Robust health coverage. Excellent health, dental and vision insurance covered up to 100% by ALSO with FSA & HSA options.
One Medical membership and dedicated insurance advocates.
Rich fertility and family building benefits with Progyny.
Flexible time off.
401(k) match.

Why ALSO.

We’re passionate about helping the world find a better way to get there—wherever it is you’re headed.

We’re located in the heart of Silicon Valley and have brought together a world-class team from some of the biggest brands in the technology, automotive, cycling, outdoor recreation and retail spaces.

Together we’re working hands-on to imagine, design and build an entirely new solution to a global set of transportation challenges.

We’re ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life-from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.

As part of the global ALTEN Group-57,000+ engineers in 30 countries-we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing.

When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you’ll collaborate on some of the world’s toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.

As a Technical Program Manager - Hardware and Software

Drive execution of complex, multi-team robotics software programs, focusing on delivery of integrated capabilities spanning multiple features and workstreams.
Coordinate across multiple software, hardware, and systems teams, managing interdependencies to ensure aligned delivery of end-to-end functionality rather than isolated feature execution.
Translate high-level product goals into structured execution plans, defining timelines, dependencies, and milestones across distributed teams.
Operate with a high degree of ownership to manage ambiguity, independently driving program direction while aligning to broader organizational goals.
Partner closely with engineering teams to understand technical problem spaces, including system services, architectures, and algorithms that support feature development.
Develop a working knowledge of robotics software stacks, including motion planning, trajectory generation, navigation, and related services, to effectively manage program execution.
Support feature validation by working alongside engineers in lab environments, assisting with system bring-up, running work cells, and validating feature performance against defined KPIs.
Build trust with software development teams by engaging directly in execution workflows and understanding system behavior beyond planning artifacts.
Oversee program execution using Agile methodologies, ensuring coordination across teams without focusing on individual team sprint or ticket management.
Track program progress through defined metrics, ensuring readiness for deployment and successful integration into operational environments.
Support both new product development and sustaining engineering efforts for deployed robotic systems.
Contribute to planning and execution across multiple product lines and future initiatives within the robotics portfolio.

Qualifications;

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related technical discipline.
7+ years of experience in Technical Program Management or similar role supporting complex software, hardware, and/or robotics programs.
Strong understanding of software and hardware systems, with ability to engage in technical discussions related to architecture, services, and algorithms.
Experience managing cross-team dependencies and delivering integrated systems composed of multiple features and components.
Familiarity with robotics concepts such as motion planning, navigation, and autonomous system behavior (or demonstrated ability to learn quickly).
Experience working in Agile development environments.
Ability to operate independently in high-ambiguity, fast-paced environments while driving outcomes.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across engineering and product teams.
Willingness to work hands-on in lab or development environments alongside engineering teams.

Salary Range: $140,000 - $200,000

The actual salary offered is dependent on various factors including, but not limited to, location, the candidate’s combination of job-related knowledge, qualifications, skills, education, training, and experience

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy.

Please beware of job seeker scams and see this important notice on our careers page for more information about our recruiting process.

new_jobs.title: Business Automation & AI Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
At AKS
, we are growing and building for the future. We bring together multidisciplined experts across the land development, energy, and infrastructure markets to take on bigger challenges and deliver solutions that make a real difference. Our teams combine creativity, technical excellence, and a collaborative, hands-on approach to solve complex problems and deliver results our clients and communities can count on. We take pride in our work and our ability to provide opportunities for our teams, support each other’s growth, and look ahead to what’s next. When you join AKS, you will ﬁnd opportunities to take ownership of meaningful projects, learn, lead, and make an impact from day one.

The Business Automation & AI Program Manager leads AKS’s strategy and execution for artificial intelligence, workflow automation, business process improvement, application development, systems integration, data, and analytics. This role partners closely with executives, discipline leaders, department leaders, and technical teams to understand how work is performed today, identify opportunities for improvement, and turn those opportunities into practical, secure, scalable digital solutions. The ideal candidate is curious, collaborative, technically capable, and highly business-oriented. They are comfortable discussing AI strategy with executives, mapping a process with discipline leaders, reviewing an API integration with developers, and demonstrating a new digital solution to employees.

What You’ll Do

Lead the enterprise roadmap for artificial intelligence, automation, data, and digital transformation.
Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities based on business impact, complexity, risk, and organizational readiness.
Lead practical adoption of generative AI, enterprise AI assistants, AI agents, workflow automation, and data-driven tools.
Ensure AI and automation initiatives are tied to measurable business outcomes rather than technology for technology’s sake.
Work directly with discipline and department leaders to understand current-state business processes and proactively identify manual, repetitive, spreadsheet-driven, email-driven, or disconnected processes that can be simplified, improved, automated, or redesigned.
Design improved future-state processes and determine when automation, applications, integrations, analytics, or AI are appropriate.
Challenge existing processes when appropriate rather than simply automating the way work is performed today, with a focus on simplifying and improving the process before technology is applied.
Provide leadership and technical direction for Microsoft Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse, and related Power Platform capabilities.
Establish standards for environments, security, development, testing, documentation, deployment, support, and lifecycle management.
Provide leadership, prioritization, technical direction, and mentorship to team members and technical resources responsible for delivering Power Platform, automation, integration, data , and AI solutions.
Set the organization’s Microsoft Fabric and OneLake direction in partnership with IT, data teams, and vendors.
Guide enterprise data integration, pipelines, semantic models, Power BI and analytics capabilities, data quality, governance, and security.
Define the strategy for integrating enterprise systems using REST APIs, JSON, HTTP, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, connectors, and related technologies.
Build strong, trusted relationships with executives, discipline leaders, department leaders, technical teams, and end users.
Lead organization adoption of new AI, automation, and digital solutions through stakeholder engagement, communication, demonstrations, pilot programs, training, feedback, and change management.
Translate business challenges into technology opportunities and explain technical concepts clearly to nontechnical audiences.
Establish success metrics and measure the business impact of initiatives, including hours saved, cycle-time reduction, error reduction, user adoption, ,improved data quality,, cost avoidance, and other measurable operational improvements.
Establish and maintain governance for AI usage, Power Platform development, data access, security, documentation, solution ownership, and lifecycle management.
Manage a portfolio of AI, automation, integration, data, and analytics initiatives.

Who You Are

Experience with Power Platform solutions, environment management, connection references, environment variables, deployment between development/test/production environments, and application lifecycle management.
Demonstrated experience with business process analysis, process improvement, and converting manual or inefficient processes into scalable digital workflows.
Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Power Automate, Power Apps, and Power BI, with the ability to provide technical direction and evaluate solution approaches.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Dataverse, or comparable enterprise data platforms.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and system integration patterns.
Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into practical technical solutions.
Strong understanding of data governance, access controls, security, permissions, and enterprise data architecture.
Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and relationship-building skills.
Ability to build credibility and trusted relationships with technical and nontechnical stakeholders, influence change across departments, and drive successful adoption of new technologies, processes, and ways of working.
Personable, approachable leadership style with the ability to build genuine trust and relationships across field crews, engineers, surveyors, project teams, and executives; a strong cultural fit for a collaborative, hands-on AEC organization.
Strong project and program management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Nice To Have

Experience leading an enterprise AI, automation, or digital transformation program, including generative AI, AI agents, RAG, LLMs, or enterprise AI platforms.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Data Factory, semantic models, and Power Platform governance or Center of Excellence practices.
Experience with Azure, SQL, Python, PowerShell, or other data and integration technologies.
Experience integrating ERP, HR, finance, project management, CRM, or other enterprise business systems.
Experience supporting an architecture, engineering, construction (AEC), surveying, or land development organization, with an understanding of field operations, project delivery, and how platforms such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, or Revit fit into the broader technology and data ecosystem.

Why AKS?

At AKS, we believe your work should support your life, not the other way around. Here's what you can count on when you join our team:

Meaningful Growth:
Whether you're just starting out or looking to advance, we offer hands-on training, mentorship, and clear paths for professional development so you can grow with purpose.
Real Collaboration:
Join a team that brings diverse perspectives together to solve complex challenges with creativity, curiosity, and a shared commitment to quality.
Respect for Your Time:
We value work-life balance and offer generous PTO and a supportive environment that helps you manage both personal and professional responsibilities.
Benefits That Care:
You’ll have access to health coverage that supports your total well-being, plus a 401(k) match, paid holidays, and more resources to help you thrive.
Weekly Team Lunches:
Take a break and recharge with your teammates, we believe food brings people together.
Culture That Connects:
We invest in experiences that build strong teams and strong communities.
A Place People Love to Work:
We’ve been named one of the Top Workplaces year after year.

Join us and be part of a team that values your contributions, celebrates initiative, and is committed to doing things the right way for our employees, clients, and communities.

Project Manager

The Project Manager is responsible for planning, executing, and closing projects on time, on spec, and on budget. This role involves managing resources, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring projects align with the organization's strategic objectives. The Project Manager will handle moderately complex projects, contributing expertise in project management methodologies and best practices. The incumbent will be in charge of the project execution and ensure full compliance with the P.Q.P rules: Prevention, Quality, and Productivity.

Plan and execute the project according to Boccard Project Management System and internal best practices in place
Accountable for delivering the project On Time, On Spec, and On Budget
Track Project performance and meet budgetary objectives until project closure. Manage project budgets and report estimated versus actual costs, against physical progress. Analyze and explain technical and budgetary variances
Carry out project closeout, prepare project postmortem and report final project KPIs

new_jobs.title: Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
The Role

The Senior ERP Business Analyst will play a key role in understanding how our clients operate today, identifying business and system challenges, defining future-state requirements, and translating business needs into clear requirements for ERP vendors and implementation teams.
This is a hands-on, client-facing consulting role requiring strong analytical skills, business process knowledge, ERP experience, and the ability to facilitate discussions with stakeholders across multiple departments.

The successful candidate will work across engagements including ERP assessments, business process reviews, system selections, ERP implementations, testing, and post-implementation improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

Business Process & Requirements Analysis

Facilitate discovery sessions and requirements-gathering workshops with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, department leaders, and end users.
Document current-state business processes, workflows, systems, integrations, pain points, and manual processes.
Identify process inefficiencies, system limitations, duplicate activities, manual workarounds, and opportunities for improvement.
Develop detailed business, functional, reporting, integration, and system requirements.
Translate business needs into clear requirements that can be understood by ERP vendors, implementation partners, and technical teams.
Develop current-state and future-state process flows and supporting documentation.
Identify opportunities to streamline, standardize, automate, and improve business processes.
Work with stakeholders to prioritize requirements based on business importance and project objectives.
Ensure requirements are complete, accurate, traceable, and aligned with the overall project scope.

ERP Assessment & System Selection

Support ERP assessment and system selection engagements from discovery through final recommendation.
Assess how well existing systems support current and future business requirements.
Assist in identifying functional and technology gaps within the client's existing environment.
Develop detailed ERP requirements for inclusion in RFPs, RFIs, and vendor evaluations.
Work with ERP vendors to clarify business and functional requirements.
Develop ERP demonstration scripts and business scenarios based on client requirements.
Participate in vendor demonstrations and evaluate how effectively proposed solutions meet requirements.
Assist with vendor scoring, evaluation matrices, gap analysis, and solution comparisons.
Document findings and contribute to ERP recommendations and technology roadmaps.
Support the preparation and presentation of findings and recommendations to client stakeholders and executives.

ERP Implementation Support

Work closely with client teams, Project Managers, ERP vendors, and implementation partners throughout implementation.
Validate that proposed system designs and configurations align with documented business requirements.
Participate in solution design and configuration workshops.
Maintain requirements traceability throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Identify gaps between business requirements and proposed system functionality.
Assist with decisions regarding process changes, configuration, integrations, reporting, and system functionality.
Support data migration activities, including data requirements, mapping, validation, and reconciliation.
Assist with identifying reporting, dashboard, and analytics requirements.
Support integration requirements between the ERP and third-party applications.

Client & Stakeholder Management

Build strong relationships with client stakeholders across multiple departments and organizational levels.
Facilitate productive workshops and discussions involving stakeholders with different requirements and priorities.
Communicate business and system issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Present findings, requirements, process recommendations, and system gaps in a clear and professional manner.
Work collaboratively with AIS Project Managers, consultants, technical resources, clients, and ERP vendors.
Maintain high-quality project documentation throughout each engagement.

Qualifications

5+ years of Business Analyst experience
, preferably with significant ERP or enterprise systems experience.
Demonstrated experience gathering and documenting business and functional requirements.
Experience participating in ERP implementations, system selections, business process improvement initiatives, or technology assessments
.

Finance and Accounting
Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable
Procurement and Purchasing
Inventory and Warehouse Management
Supply Chain
Sales and Order Management
Manufacturing
Fixed Assets
Reporting and Analytics
Experience facilitating requirements workshops and stakeholder interviews.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, NetSuite, Sage, Infor, Epicor, Oracle, or comparable solutions.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager & Operations Integration Lead
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter . Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.

The Space and Intelligence Division provides professional services to the US Space Force, Combatant Commands, Intelligence Community, and NASA. Our work includes enterprise architectural assessments, systems engineering and integration, test, planning and execution, cost estimating and analysis, acquisition support, and cybersecurity. We are trusted partners developing approaches and concepts to meet emerging high priority needs, assessing cutting-edge technologies, and supporting capabilities for our National Defense. Come join the fastest growing Division at Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc.

The Strategic Technology Analysis Group, part of SPA’s Space and Intelligence Division, offers sophisticated capabilities (people, process & tools) to resolve unique problems in space, cyber, and special operations in support to military services, Secretary of Defense offices (OSD) and theater warfighters. Our portfolio includes the Assistant Secretary of Air Force for Space Acquisition & Integration (SAF/SQ), Joint Warfare Analysis Center (JWAC), Space Security and Defense Program (SSDP), National Space Defense Center (NSDC), Space Warfighting Analysis Center (SWAC), Strategic Capabilities Office (SCO), US Space Command (USSPACECOM) and US Space Force (USSF). Come be a part of a high-speed low-drag organization providing unique and tailored solutions for our National Defense!

SPA has an immediate need for a Program Manager & Operations Integration Lead.

Responsibilities

The successful candidate will support the USSF to conduct test campaigns across space mission areas to satisfy Operational Test & Evaluation requirements and validate system performance and tactics, techniques, and procedures. This will include supporting a foundational simulation environment with integrated third-party models and simulations, such as blue models from program offices and intel-validated red models. You will support the High-End Advanced, Test, Training, and Tactics Development (HEAT3) effort under USSF System Delta (SYD) 81. In all activities, the candidate will work closely with internal and external teams to drive effective collaboration and deliver a superior solution.

The key duties associated with this position include, but are not limited, to the following:

Provide technical program management, providing the primary interfacing and representation between SPA personnel located across all sites. Activities include:
Provide primary interfacing and representation between SPA personnel at all sites and the client Program Manager, including status, blockers, upcoming activities, and cross-site coordination.
Attend all scheduled Technical Exchange Meetings and other forums in support of HEAT3 execution.
Assist client in user story selection and review, including the active management of requirements traceability, prioritization decisions, and acceptance criteria validation.
Provide and regularly update internal-use program management products such as stakeholder registry and risk registry.
Coordinate with internal SPA leadership, teaming partners, and client to identify, capture, and resolve programmatic risks and issues at the earliest possible point.
Support documentation, configuration management, and version control of all PM artifacts produced under this Task.

Support security staff in coordinating Co-Usage Agreements (CUA) and Joint-Usage Agreements (JUA) as early as possible after award, and get team members set up with the appropriate accounts to support classified deployments remotely, wherever possible, as well as Colorado Springs SCIF/SAPF use between SSC/BMC3I and SYD 81.
Oversee remote engineering support as well as domain expertise support with personnel possessing domain expertise in space systems modeling and simulation, space test and training, the Joint Simulation Environment (JSE), and other relevant areas to provide general technical support.
Oversee embedded subject matter expert (SME) and "super-user" support to the 3 TES customer site to enable delivery of the 3 TES test environment capability and successful execution of the associated Weapon System Evaluation Program (WSEP) and tactics validation campaign(s). Certain tasks may be completed by remote support personnel in coordination with client.
Oversee embedded JSE SME and "super-user" support to enable client's delivery of space effects into the JSE at JITTC-N in support of the Long-Range Kill Chain (LRKC). Equivalent “on-site” performance through frequent travel during key deployment and product release periods is acceptable. Certain tasks may be completed by remote support personnel in coordination with client.
Upon option exercise, oversee requirements discovery for and execute emergent WSEP campaigns, other USSF or Joint test and Tactics Validation campaigns, or additional capability deployments.
Attend conferences and other technical exchanges and provide reports, as required.
Collaborate and integrate across diverse teams to achieve insightful analytic findings that aid decision makers.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Current and active TS/SCI at time of application; willingness to take a poly
Master’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or Space-related discipline
10+ years of leading and integrating DoW and IC system engineering, operations research, and/or cross-domain studies and analysis
Thorough and nuanced understanding of USSF test & evaluation processes
Thorough understanding of the space domain to include astrodynamics, aerospace engineering, space system engineering, RF, optics, and directed energy applications
Excellent interpersonal and communication (oral and writing) skills with experience using critical thinking to prepare written reports and presentations for decision makers
Demonstrated initiative and ability to plan, work, and deliver both independently and as part of a diverse team focused on delivering critical assessments for decision makers
Demonstrated ability to effectively and professionally interact with staff members and executive leadership via both verbal and written means
Ability to report to designated work location in Colorado Springs, up to full time, based on the needs of the customer

Desired Qualifications

JSE system experience
3 TES, 17 TES, DEL 9, and JITTC-N user communities experience
AFSIM or REACT modeling & simulation experience
Graduate of USAF. USSF. Navy or Marine Corps Weapon School

About the role:

The AI Security Analyst is a hybrid role combining security operations monitoring with AI-specific risk management and governance support. The role focuses on identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks associated with AI use, particularly generative AI, LLMs, and agentic systems, across internal tools and customer-facing platforms, while contributing to traditional security monitoring. The role does not involve building or training AI models; it secures how AI is deployed, governed, monitored, and used.

Location: Czech Republic (Remote). Working hours for this role are aligned to U.S. Central Time (Austin) core business hours to ensure real-time collaboration with the U.S.-based security leadership and compliance team.

This role is hired through an Employer of Record (EOR) partner in the Czech Republic.

About us:

8am builds software that helps professionals run stronger businesses. Our platform powers payments, client experience, and operational workflows for legal, accounting, and other service-based businesses. U.S. based professionals count on our purpose-built solutions to simplify operations, ensure compliance, and fuel profitable growth, so they can focus on their clients and do more of the work that matters.

More than 250,000 professionals across the U.S. rely on our products every day. As we continue to grow, we're investing in the next generation of our platform and are looking for experienced engineers who want to help shape its future.

What you'll do:

AI security and risk management:
Identify and mitigate AI-specific threats: prompt injection, jailbreaking and adversarial inputs, sensitive information disclosure, insecure output handling and excessive agency, model misuse and overreliance, and supply chain vulnerabilities in third-party AI services and models.
AI use-case review:
Triage and risk-assess proposed AI use cases with Engineering, Product, Legal, and Privacy before production deployment; recommend controls and document decisions.
Agentic governance support:
Support the operation of the company's agentic-work governance model: autonomy classification reviews, agent activity monitoring, and evidence collection for governance reviews.
Vendor and model review:
Evaluate third-party AI vendors, model providers, and AI-enabled features for security posture and data handling; maintain the approved-provider view.
Security operations and monitoring:
Perform SOC-style monitoring, alert triage, and investigation across cloud, application, and AI-enabled systems, including AI API usage and data flows; enhance detection rules and logging for AI-specific activity.
Compliance and governance support:
Support audit readiness for SOC 2 and PCI DSS and alignment with emerging AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, OWASP LLM Top 10, ISO/IEC 42001 as the program matures); document AI security controls and risk assessments.
Incident support:
Support AI-related incident response, investigation, and post-incident analysis.

About you:

3+ years in security operations, security analysis, or GRC with hands-on technical exposure.
Working understanding of LLM-specific threat classes (OWASP LLM Top 10) and AI risk frameworks (NIST AI RMF).
Ability to read logs, write basic queries and scripts, and investigate independently.
Strong written English and documentation discipline; comfortable in a distributed team.
Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools and technologies to improve workflows, enhance decision-making, or drive innovation.
This position is preferably based in Brno, Czech Republic

Experience monitoring or governing agentic AI systems, MCP integrations, or AI developer tooling.
Fintech, legal-tech, or other regulated-industry background.

Drive our "AI-First" Transformation:
We are building a secure, massive-scale "Unified AI Platform". Depending on your squad, you will either help architect this core infrastructure (LLM routing, RAG, agent orchestration) or build directly on top of it.
Build the Next Generation of Our Platform:
Help shape the systems powering products used by more than 250,000 professionals. You'll work on complex platform capabilities across payments, workflow automation, and AI-powered features as we expand into new professional service markets.

and employee referral rewards

new_jobs.description:
Overview

Western Digital is entering a new chapter. Following our spin-off of SanDisk, we are stepping into our future as an independent deep-tech company, one built on decades of engineering breakthroughs and pointed squarely at the biggest technological frontiers of our time.

We are a company of physicists, materials scientists, AI researchers, and engineers. We work at the frontier of magnetics, photonics, nanofabrication, and machine learning - disciplines most people never encounter, solving problems most people don't know exist. Our teams hold one of the largest intellectual property banks in Silicon Valley, and our labs are staffed with hundreds of PhDs who've spent their careers pushing what's physically possible.

Most folks know us as a data storage company, powering data centers, hyperscale clouds, and AI systems that define the modern economy. HDD is the backbone of the AI economy and the most scalable, cost-efficient way to store the world's data - and we're building its future. But it's only part of the story. In the past, our technology has helped put a man on the moon and captured the first-ever picture of a black hole. The next generation of what we are building will shape robotics, quantum computing, space systems, personalized medicine, autonomous vehicles, and more. We are entering the most ambitious phase of our company's history. As AI reshapes every industry and every workload, the world needs more data infrastructure, better materials science, and deeper engineering talent than ever before. That's what we do. That's what we've always done. And we're just getting started.

Western Digital's Strategy & Corporate Development team is the connective tissue bridging Western Digital's technology to the markets it will serve. We turn deep-tech capability into commercial impact, strengthening our position in the core HDD business, setting the company's long-term strategy, and executing the partnerships, investments, and acquisitions that shape what we build next.

If you want to work on problems that matter at the intersection of deep technology, business strategy, and real-world impact, we would love to talk.

Join us. Let's build what comes next.

Job Description

Track timelines, synthesize cross-functional inputs, and deliver against tight deadlines with minimal supervision while escalating appropriately on critical decisions.

Research & Analysis

Synthesize insights from diverse sources into clear analytical conclusions that inform strategic recommendations.

Executive Deliverables

Translate complex analysis into clear, compelling narratives suitable for senior leadership consumption.

Develop quantitative frameworks that underpin strategic recommendations with rigor and defensibility.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to align on strategic priorities, gather inputs, and drive recommendations through to decisions.
Build trusted relationships with commercial, product, and finance stakeholders and drive alignment independently.

Qualifications

Minimum of 3–6 years experience overall with minimum 2 spent in consulting, corporate strategy, investment banking, or a research-intensive analytical role; progressive career trajectory with increasing scope, ownership, and complexity of work over time.
Demonstrated ability to own and lead complex strategic projects end-to-end with C-suite output quality, from problem structuring through to final recommendation.
Strong financial and analytical acumen including models, scenario analysis, and business case development; comfortable with quantitative frameworks.
Experience conducting primary research (expert interviews, customer conversations, channel checks) and secondary research (industry reports, analyst research, public filings) to inform strategic recommendations.
Strong cross-functional collaborator who can build trusted relationships with commercial, product, and finance stakeholders; drives alignment independently.
Experience working with senior leaders and delivering executive-level deliverables independently.
Solid Excel and PowerPoint skills; data visualization a plus.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience supporting or embedded in commercial, GTM, or sales organizations preferred

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience in deep technology, data storage, semiconductor, or enterprise infrastructure.
Experience with competitive intelligence or market research tools (e.g., PitchBook, Bloomberg, Gartner).

Education

MBA or equivalent work experience preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Economics, Finance, or a related analytical field.

Location

San Jose, California (must be willing to relocate)
Flexibility for remote work within established company policies.
10-20% travel including domestic and international travel to meet with targets, advisors, investors, partners, and industry events.

This is a high-impact analytical role at the center of Western Digital's corporate strategy function, offering direct exposure to the Executive Leadership Team on the company's most important strategic questions. The Associate will independently drive strategic projects championed by senior executives on a wide range of topics and business areas that cover core business (HDD, data storage, infrastructure, AI/cloud) and New Ventures. About Us

Rockstar Original is a fast-growing fashion and e-commerce brand built around bold, trend-driven apparel and a culture of creativity, hustle, and innovation. We move quickly, continuously evolve, and are always looking for better ways to operate as we grow.
Our team is collaborative and hands-on. We value people who take ownership, bring ideas to the table, and aren't afraid to step outside of their job description when something needs to get done.
As our business continues to scale and invest in new warehouse technology, strong systems, data visibility, and fulfillment processes are essential to delivering the experience our customers expect. We're looking for someone who can help us build a smarter, more efficient, and increasingly automated fulfillment operation.

Position Summary

The Fulfillment Systems & Operations Analyst will be responsible for monitoring and improving the systems, workflows, and day-to-day performance behind Rockstar Original's e-commerce fulfillment operation.
This is not a traditional Warehouse Manager position. We're looking for someone who understands how modern e-commerce fulfillment works across WMS, Shopify, ERP/order systems, inventory, shipping, warehouse processes, data, and automation and can connect those pieces to keep orders flowing efficiently.
Working closely with warehouse leadership and cross-functional teams, this person will monitor order volume and fulfillment performance, identify bottlenecks and system issues, troubleshoot problems, and help ensure customer orders are processed accurately and within established SLAs.
This role will also play an important part in the continued evolution of our fulfillment operation, including our WMS environment, systems integrations, process improvements, and future warehouse automation and robotics initiatives.
The ideal candidate is equally comfortable analyzing an order queue or KPI, troubleshooting a WMS workflow, walking the warehouse floor to understand a bottleneck, and working with internal teams or technology partners to implement a better solution.

Key Responsibilities

Monitor daily e-commerce order flow and fulfillment performance, including order volume, aging orders, backlog, throughput, processing times, order accuracy, and on-time shipment rate.
Analyze fulfillment data and operational KPIs to identify bottlenecks, exceptions, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve order throughput and SLA performance.
Become a key operational resource for our Warehouse Management System (WMS), with Infios experience strongly preferred.
Monitor and troubleshoot workflows between the WMS, Shopify, ERP/order systems, shipping platforms, inventory systems, and other fulfillment technologies.
Investigate system, inventory, workflow, picking, packing, shipping, and order-processing issues and drive them toward resolution.
Perform root-cause analysis when orders fall behind or fulfillment performance deviates from established targets.
Work closely with warehouse leadership to develop and execute recovery plans when fulfillment falls behind.
Help maintain accurate and reliable order and inventory data across interconnected systems.
Identify opportunities to improve picking, packing, shipping, replenishment, inventory movement, order prioritization, and overall warehouse workflow.
Build and maintain reporting and visibility around key fulfillment metrics, trends, exceptions, and operational risks.
Proactively identify issues that could impact fulfillment before they develop into larger backlogs or customer-facing problems.
Support the implementation, testing, optimization, and adoption of new WMS functionality, integrations, workflows, and warehouse technology.
Participate in future warehouse automation and robotics initiatives, helping connect new technology with existing WMS processes and operational workflows.
Work cross-functionally with Warehouse, Operations, Customer Service, Inventory, E-Commerce, IT/technology partners, and other teams to resolve fulfillment-related issues.
Document processes, system workflows, standard operating procedures, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
Help evaluate how increasing order volume, SKU count, inventory levels, warehouse capacity, and peak demand affect fulfillment performance and system requirements.

Qualifications

Experience working in e-commerce fulfillment, warehouse systems, supply chain operations, logistics technology, or a similar environment.
Strong hands-on experience with a Warehouse Management System (WMS) required; Infios WMS experience is strongly preferred.
Experience working with Shopify in an e-commerce fulfillment or operations environment strongly preferred.
Familiarity with ERP, OMS (Order Management Systems), inventory management, shipping, and other integrated business systems.
Understanding of how orders and inventory data move between e-commerce platforms, ERP/OMS systems, WMS platforms, and shipping systems.
Experience analyzing operational data including orders per day, units on hand, SKU volume, order backlog, fulfillment throughput, processing time, and shipping SLA performance.
Strong understanding of warehouse fulfillment processes, including receiving, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, inventory movement, and order prioritization.
Experience troubleshooting system and operational issues and performing root-cause analysis.
Familiarity with warehouse automation, robotics, AMRs, conveyors, automated picking/sorting systems, or other material handling technologies is highly desirable.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn operational data into action.
Comfortable learning new technology and working between software systems and physical warehouse operations.
Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with both operational and technical teams.
Highly proactive, organized, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities and order volume can change quickly.
Bilingual Spanish/English required.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who thinks about fulfillment as an interconnected operation of systems, data, people, processes, and technology.

The ideal candidate:

Understands both the physical flow of products and the digital flow of orders and inventory through an e-commerce fulfillment operation.
Can look at order volume, units on hand, backlog, throughput, processing times, and other operational data and quickly understand what is happening.
Knows their way around a WMS and is comfortable investigating why an order, inventory transaction, or workflow isn't behaving as expected.
Understands how platforms such as Shopify, WMS, ERP, OMS, shipping systems, and warehouse technology work together.
Doesn't just report that fulfillment is behind—they investigate why and help drive the solution.
Is excited by warehouse technology, systems integration, automation, and robotics rather than intimidated by them.
Can move comfortably between analyzing data at a computer and walking the warehouse floor to understand what's actually happening.
Thinks in terms of process optimization, scalability, automation, and continuous improvement.
Takes ownership and follows problems through to resolution.
Wants to help build the next generation of Rockstar Original's fulfillment operation rather than simply maintain the status quo.

Competitive Salary:
$120,000–$180,000 annually, dependent on experience and qualifications
Health Benefits:
Health benefits available
Paid Time Off:
PTO accrual
Growth Opportunity:
Opportunity to play a key role in the continued development and modernization of our fulfillment and operations systems
Employee Perks:
Additional company benefits and employee perks available

At Imperial, we work every day to responsibly develop Canada’s energy resources – applying technology and innovation to supply affordable, accessible and reliable energy while reducing emissions. Imperial recognizes the important role we can play by advancing climate solutions within our operations and by providing lower life-cycle emission products to our customers. This effort is powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by a pride in what we do and what we stand for.

The success of our upstream, downstream and chemical, and corporate divisions is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower-emissions technologies.

Imperial honours diverse backgrounds so we can be a place where people can bring their full selves to work, no matter their identity, race, gender, sexual orientation, age, or ability.

At Imperial, we want you to come for the position and stay for the career. As an integrated company, we are uniquely positioned to offer you a wide range of career prospects and growth opportunities through the course of your career with us. We invite you to bring your ideas and help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs.

Come be part of the Upstream and Global Operations Departments at Imperial which has more than 140 year history in Canada. Our offices are located across Canada.

The Business Analyst Student will work as part of an integrated team within the Upstream Digital Accelerator, helping deliver digital innovation and solve operational challenges across our mining and in situ oil sands operations.

The student will collaborate with site operators, engineers, business stakeholders, data scientists, software developers, and management to understand business needs and translate them into practical digital solutions. Depending on the project, the student may help define requirements, map business processes, analyze data, develop business cases and project plans, coordinate activities, and design or prototype technology solutions.

About Air Apps

At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal in 2018—and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco—we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.

Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.

Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.

The Role

As a Data Analyst
at Air Apps, you will be responsible for analyzing and interpreting data
to drive business insights and optimize product performance. You will create reports, dashboards, and performance metrics
to help teams make informed decisions and improve user experience.

This role requires a data-driven mindset, strong analytical skills, and experience with visualization tools
to turn complex data into actionable insights.

Responsibilities

Analyze user behavior, product performance, and key business metrics to identify trends and opportunities.
Create and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using tools like Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or Google Data Studio.
Collect, clean, and structure large datasets to ensure accuracy and usability.
Define and track KPIs for marketing, product, and business performance.
Work with SQL, Python, or R to extract, analyze, and manipulate data.
Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and marketing teams to provide data-driven insights.
Conduct A/B testing and experiment analysis to improve product features and user engagement.
Identify bottlenecks and opportunities in user journeys and customer funnels.
Present findings in a clear and compelling way to stakeholders and leadership teams.
Stay up to date with industry trends, analytics best practices, and emerging data tools.

Requirements

Around 3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field.
Proficiency in SQL for data querying and manipulation.
Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Google Data Studio).
Strong analytical skills with experience in Python or R for data analysis.
Knowledge of A/B testing methodologies and statistical analysis.
Experience with Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar user analytics tools.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience working with large datasets and cloud-based data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake).
Familiarity with ETL processes and data pipeline optimization is a plus.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and manage multiple projects.

new_jobs.title: Product Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
IMPORTANT: Please be aware, scammers may try to impersonate Zello by reaching out regarding job opportunities. We will never ask you for bank account information, checks, or other sensitive information as part of our hiring process. All correspondence will come from the zello.com email domain. If you’re unsure, please email recruiting@zello.com with questions.

About Zello

Zello is a voice-first communication platform, powered by our industry-leading push-to-talk technology, to improve collaboration and productivity for desk-less workers. With over 175+ million users, we’re the #1 rated push-to-talk app in the world, delivering 9 billion (yes, with a B) messages a month.

At Zello, our company values are at the heart of what we do everyday. We’re proud to serve the frontline, we’re privileged to connect people in times of crisis across the globe, and we’re honored to support first responders.

And this is where you come in.

We're hiring a Product Data Analyst to help us figure out where the product goes next. Zello is push-to-talk for frontline workers - millions of people use it to do their jobs every day - and we want someone who can turn what we see in the data into clear calls about what to build. You'd join the Data & AI team here in Austin.

This one's hands-on and heavily AI-leveraged. You'll dig into the data, form hypotheses, spec the telemetry for our web and mobile apps, run the experiments, and call what ships and what doesn't. You'll lean on AI agents to handle the routine work so your time goes to the thinking that actually moves things.

After a successful first year, you will have

Run 10+ well-powered product experiments end to end, from hypothesis and telemetry spec through analysis to a clear ship-or-kill call, with real impact on activation or conversion.
Defined the events and metrics for a couple of product areas so PMs can pull their own numbers instead of waiting on you.
Shaped the roadmap with your analysis - at least three features that shipped or got killed because of what you found.
Built an AI-leveraged workflow where agents handle the routine pulls, first-pass analysis, and write-ups, so one analyst covers a lot more ground.
Become the person your pod pulls in early, not at the end.

What you'll do

Work with PMs, designers, and engineers to define product metrics, events, and what success looks like.
Design and run A/B tests - scope the hypothesis, make sure it's powered, analyze it honestly, and recommend a call.
Build funnel, retention, and cohort analysis on our mobile and web data with SQL and Python on Snowflake.
Build and run AI-agent workflows that take the grunt work off your plate, and check what they hand back.
Keep the core product dashboards in Omni current so the team isn't waiting on you for the basics.
Turn the analysis into a clear story and a recommendation people can act on.

Who you are

You've owned A/B tests end to end and can point to decisions that changed because of your work, not just dashboards you built.
You write advanced SQL on your own against a cloud warehouse, and you reach for Python when it helps.
You've already reworked how you work around AI - handing routine analysis to agents and checking their output - and you want to push that further.
You pick the right method for the data in front of you instead of running the same test every time.
You don't wait for perfect data. You build the analysis, pressure-test it, and bring a recommendation.
You make work easier for the people around you. PMs and designers find you straightforward to work with.

This role is not

A dashboard or BI-reporting job - dashboards support the work, they're not the work.
A data engineering or pipeline role - the team's got that covered.
A management role - this is a senior IC.
For someone who needs every query and metric handed to them.

We hire for potential, passion for our mission, and a knack for solving difficult problems over checking every qualification box. We have competitive pay, equity with significant upside, and intentionally design our benefits to encourage healthy and well-balanced employees, flexible schedules and time off. We even offer a sabbatical after every five years of service so you’re able to pursue and enjoy what matters most to you. And of course, we wouldn’t be a technology company without a ping-pong table and free snacks in our break room. Join us!

new_jobs.description:
Description

The Work
: At ICF, we combine deep domain expertise with leading-edge technology to help our clients solve their most complex challenges. We are seeking a Data Analyst whose expertise is embedded as part of a User Acceptance Testing Team, supporting mission-driven data and analytics modernization programs that deliver measurable impact.

As a Data Analyst / Embedded UAT Tester you will bring strong expertise in data analytics, SQL-based analysis, data validation, and Databricks workflows. You will also support the validation of user workflows, system functionality, usability, and release readiness through structured user acceptance testing and collaboration with business, technical, product, and QA stakeholders. You will help ensure that modern data platforms, analytic outputs, dashboards, and user workflows are accurate, usable, accessible, and aligned with mission needs.

Job Location:
This position requires that the job be performed in the United States. If you accept this position, you should note that ICF does monitor employee work locations and blocks access from foreign locations/foreign IP addresses, and also prohibits personal VPN connections.

You may be asked to travel once a quarter to an office.

new_jobs.title: Junior Health Data Analyst - Hybrid/On Site
new_jobs.description:
Under general supervision, works collaboratively across teams within GBMC to develop and maintain data collection, measurement tools, and databases to support data analysis in support of health improvement initiatives, value-based care programs, and other health outcome data monitoring requirements. Analyses produced will assist in carrying out GBHA’s goals of improving the health and quality of care of the populations for which it is responsible, to improve their experience of care, and to reduce the per capita cost of their care.

Location:

GBMC, Towson, MD - this is a hybrid position

Education

Bachelor’s degree required.

Master’s degree in Business, Health Administration, Finance or related field preferred.

Experience

2+ years of experience required.

Experience in health administration, data analytics, or related field preferred.

Skills

Data literacy (ability to read, write, and communicate data in context)
Conceptual analytical and quantitative skills.
Data collection, manipulation, and analysis skills.
Comfort with working in a self-driven, start-up environment.
Interest in and active pursuit of opportunities to learn and grow, and ability to handle multiple demands, shifting priorities, crises, and rapid change
Knowledge of management, business planning, finance, and healthcare.
Working knowledge of finance, accounting, financial models, healthcare data, market and competitive analysis techniques.
Skill in report testing, and supporting end users in report testing process
Able to manage multiple tasks in an uncertain and fast-paced environment
Excellent analytical and/or operational problem-solving skills; demonstrates ability to conduct and interpret quantitative/qualitative analyses and make recommendations for improvement/changes
Knowledge of health insurance claims structure and analytics, including GPRO/HEDIS Quality measures, risk adjustment methodologies, efficiency of care and utilization metrics.
Experience with large data sets, clinical quality measures, and claims analysis. Advanced skills in Excel and ease with data management (i.e. MS Access, SQL)
Skill in oral and written communication and time management with ability to effectively present to and facilitate groups

Principal Duties And Responsibilities

Works with claims data files and analytics tools to monitor aggregated and drilled down performance including risk adjusted efficiency and claims-based quality metrics
Works with the clinical and financial teams to identify trends and patterns in these complex data sets, draws conclusions, develops graphical and narrative summaries utilizing charts, graphs and images to appropriately display the information for presentation to stakeholders
Drives the design of financial and clinical outcomes reporting based on various sources including medical claims, disease registries, and electronic health records for population health activities, payer contracts, and GBMC employee health plan.
Analyzes large amounts of clinical data and turns key findings into strategic recommendations for specific clinical areas.
Design and develop reports, dashboards, scorecards, and other analytic results as necessary to support activities related to accountable care, managed care, and other GBHA goals.
Analyzes and generates reports on performance related to overall outcomes, utilization, risk adjusted total cost of care, population health, and care coordination.
Support the analysis of data from multiple sources, primarily claims files associated with value-based contracts.
Provide insight for informed decision-making and planning by identifying trends/patterns within complex data sets and visualizing and deploying the data to appropriately inform stakeholders.
Manage the technical related aspects of health analytics to support GBHA’s operational needs regarding data analysis and insight development.
Serves as subject matter expert to support the population health needs regarding claims data, value-based payer contracts, quality data and CRISP data.
Supports implementation initiatives for population health performance solutions.
Maintains current industry knowledge of healthcare financial, cost, reimbursement, market, regulatory and clinical trends, nationally and locally.

$58,488.99 - $93,582.39
